job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a temp to permanent Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-$28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 

Responsibilities
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control.  Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.

Qualifications
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

job.title: Laboratory Animal Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring an Laboratory Animal Technician for our San Francisco Bay Area client. In the Laboratory Animal Technician role, you will support the research programs of the faculty by providing all services associated with the care and use of laboratory animals including the purchasing/receiving, daily care and monitoring of the health of all species. 

Industry: Clinical Research
Location: San Francisco, Ca
Shift: M-F  7:00 am - 3:30 pm

Responsibilities 
  • Animal care, room sanitation, record keeping and minor equipment maintenance 
  • Daily maintenance of vivarium facilities, under general supervision.
  • Change cages/racks, clean primary enclosures per schedule, feed and water different species of animals 
  • Always handle animals humanely and with care. 
  • Mistreatment can result in severe, negative employment consequences.
  • Monitor room conditions for temperature, humidity, and sanitation. 
  • Report conditions outside of set ranges to your Supervisor/Principal Technician.
  • Prepare animal cages for transportation between Vivarium's/ facilities.
  • Perform cage wash duties as needed
  • Conduct all activities according to federal, state, AAALAC, and Facility requirements and regulations, including BSL 2 and higher areas.
  • Assist in the training of new employees and act as area leader of Assistant Animal Technicians.
Qualifications
  • 1 year of animal handling or lab animal sanitation equipment operations experience 
  • Ability to communicate animal health information to appropriate personnel, maintain legible records for permanent status
  • Some computer skills (email, scan barcodes, timesheets and online training)
  • Capacity to learn and assume responsibility for the routine animal caretaking functions 
  • Able to effectively and efficiently work well with other team-members in a high-throughput, dynamic, and physically demanding environment
  • Ability to effectively follow Standard Operating Procedures as it relates to Environmental Health and Safety procedures (i.e. proper use of Personal Protective Equipment)
#IND-SPG

job.title: Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance to join our insurance and mobility client. This is a foundational role responsible for defining the organization’s commercial auto strategy and determining how it should participate in emerging mobility markets, including autonomous vehicles, connected fleets, rideshare, and delivery platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial auto product expertise, a thoughtful perspective on the future of mobility, and the executive presence to develop and sell a new product vision from the ground up.

Title: Commercial Auto Product Manager, Emerging Mobility
Compensation: $194,300–$259,100 base salary, depending on experience, plus 20% target incentive
Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Location: Costa Mesa, CA or Dallas, TX
Industry: Insurance / Mobility Technology

This role is expected to be onsite most days in the Costa Mesa office. Relocation assistance may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Fully remote work is not currently planned, although limited flexibility may be explored for an outstanding candidate.

Position Overview The organization does not currently offer commercial auto insurance products and is beginning to define its strategy in this space. This person will serve as the initial product leader for the initiative, helping the business understand the opportunity, evaluate potential paths forward, and build the foundation for a future commercial auto and emerging mobility product organization.

The initial focus will be on light commercial auto and mobility segments that align with the organization’s existing operational and underwriting capabilities. This is not a heavy trucking role. The position will initially be heavily focused on strategy, market analysis, product vision, business cases, and executive alignment before transitioning into broader product development and team-building responsibilities.

Over time, the role is expected to transition from the emerging mobility strategy team into the broader insurance product management organization, potentially within 12 to 36 months as the product vision and operating model take shape.

Key Responsibilities Commercial Auto and Mobility Strategy
  • Define the organization’s long-term commercial auto and emerging mobility product strategy.

  • Evaluate opportunities across light commercial fleets, connected vehicles, autonomous vehicles, rideshare, delivery, and other evolving mobility models.

  • Explain the key differences between personal auto and commercial auto products, including risk, pricing, underwriting, coverage, claims, and operational considerations.

  • Develop a clear point of view on how autonomous and connected mobility will impact commercial insurance.

  • Monitor emerging mobility trends, competitors, OEM activity, insurance innovation, technology providers, and regulatory developments.

  • Identify where the organization can create a differentiated position in the market.

Business Case and Product Vision
  • Develop a practical roadmap for moving from the current state, with no commercial auto product, to a scalable product offering.

  • Evaluate potential paths, including building the capability internally, acquiring or partnering with an existing organization, or choosing not to enter specific market segments.

  • Analyze the investment, talent, technology, regulatory, operational, and risk requirements associated with each path.

  • Prepare recommendations and business cases for executive leadership.

  • Sell the product vision to senior executives and create alignment around the recommended strategy.

  • Define the capabilities, resources, partnerships, and organizational structure required to execute the strategy.

Product Design and Insurance Expertise
  • Provide expertise on commercial auto product structure, coverage design, underwriting, rating, pricing, and risk selection.

  • Partner with actuarial teams to evaluate pricing methodologies, risk models, exposure data, loss trends, and portfolio economics.

  • Help determine which commercial auto risks and vehicle types align with the organization’s existing capabilities.

  • Identify future coverage needs created by autonomous systems, connected vehicles, fleet operations, and changing liability models.

  • Establish the foundation for product governance, regulatory review, underwriting guidelines, and operational processes.

  • Support the development of product requirements and implementation plans as the strategy advances.

Team and Capability Development
  • Define the roles and capabilities needed to build a future commercial auto product team.

  • Recommend the organizational structure and talent profile required for execution.

  • Help recruit and build the team responsible for launching and managing the product.

  • Establish relationships across insurance product management, actuarial, underwriting, claims, legal, compliance, technology, operations, and marketing.

  • Transition from primarily strategic work into product development and execution as the initiative progresses.

Partnership and Market Development
  • Evaluate potential relationships with OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, mobility platforms, fleet operators, telematics providers, data companies, and insurance technology partners.

  • Assess embedded insurance and partnership-based distribution opportunities.

  • Represent the organization in relevant insurance, mobility, and technology discussions.

  • Develop external market perspective and bring new insights to internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, finance, economics, management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Significant experience developing or managing commercial auto insurance products.

  • Strong understanding of the differences between personal auto and commercial auto insurance.

  • Experience with commercial auto pricing, underwriting, actuarial models, risk selection, coverage structures, or portfolio performance.

  • Experience developing product strategy, business cases, market-entry plans, or new insurance capabilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an environment where the product, process, and team are still being built.

  • Strong understanding of emerging mobility, autonomous vehicles, connected vehicles, telematics, rideshare, delivery, or commercial fleet trends.

  • Ability to clearly explain how changes in mobility and vehicle technology may affect insurance products, pricing, underwriting, liability, and claims.

  • Proven ability to present recommendations and influence senior executives.

  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.

  • Ability to work onsite most days in Costa Mesa, California, or relocate to the area.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for executive meetings, industry events, and stakeholder discussions.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with autonomous vehicle companies, OEMs, commercial fleet operators, mobility platforms, telematics providers, or embedded insurance programs.

  • Experience with light commercial fleets, delivery vehicles, rideshare, or other emerging commercial mobility segments.

  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, insurtech, mobility company, or transportation technology organization.

  • Experience launching a new insurance product or building a new insurance capability from the ground up.

  • Experience evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquisition strategies.

  • Experience with E&S, specialty, non-standard, or other complex insurance products.

  • Experience with state insurance filings, regulatory approvals, product governance, or compliance.

  • CPCU, AINS, ARM, or another insurance designation.

  • Experience building and leading a product management or insurance strategy team.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Build the commercial auto strategy from the ground up.

  • Define how a major insurance organization approaches emerging mobility.

  • Work directly with senior executives and influence a significant new business direction.

  • Shape the product vision, operating model, partnerships, and future team.

  • Help determine whether the organization should build, buy, or partner to enter the market.

  • Join at the earliest stage of a long-term commercial auto and autonomous mobility initiative.

job.title: MATERIAL HANDLER - GLOUCESTER, MA
job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!
Material Handler
Applied Materials | Gloucester, MA | Long-Term 18 Month Contract
First, Second & Fourth Shift Opportunities Available

This is an opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps produce the technology powering today’s world while building valuable manufacturing and supply chain experience. Why Applied Materials?
  • World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
  • Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
  • Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
  • Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and operations.
  • Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
  • Excellent reputation in Gloucester and Newburyport for developing talent.

job.title: Supply Chain Specialist
job.description:
Supply Chain Specialist
We are seeking a hands-on Supply Chain Specialist to support materials management, purchasing, inventory control, and supplier coordination for low-volume hardware builds. This is a tactical execution role focused on ensuring materials, inventory, and manufacturing operations run efficiently while supporting engineering teams through prototype and production builds. The ideal candidate has experience in a small to mid-sized hardware company, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and thrives in fast-paced environments.

Scope:
• Manage materials, inventory, purchasing, and supplier activities supporting hardware builds.
• Create and manage purchase orders, track deliveries, and coordinate material availability.
• Support engineering builds through material planning, kitting, and production readiness.
• Develop and improve SOPs for inventory, receiving, kitting, and material handling.
• Drive operational efficiencies through inventory controls, barcode solutions, and process improvements.
• Manage engineering change orders (ECOs), BOM revisions, and material updates.
• Coordinate logistics, supplier communications, and delivery schedules.
• Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to resolve material shortages and production issues.
• Support occasional coordination with overseas suppliers during off-hours.
• Travel approximately 10% to supplier or manufacturing locations as needed.

Required:
• 2–5 years of experience in supply chain, materials management, buyer/planner, logistics, or manufacturing operations within a hardware environment.
• Experience with purchasing, inventory management, supplier coordination, and material planning.
• Experience supporting engineering or manufacturing builds through kitting and production readiness.
• Familiarity with BOM management, engineering change orders (ECOs), and ERP/MRP systems.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Self-starter who is comfortable working independently and solving day-to-day operational challenges.

Pluses:
• Experience supporting optics, semiconductor, or other precision hardware manufacturing.
• Experience implementing inventory tracking, barcode, or warehouse management solutions.
• Familiarity with prototype or NPI hardware builds and contract manufacturers.

job.title: Director, Workplace Technology Operations
job.description:
Director, Workplace Technology Operations - W2 only
This position is a permanent direct hire role with management responsibilities
Requirement for 3 days weekly onsite
Salary range $135-155K plus 20% bonus plus benefits + Management perks 

OVERVIEW Director, Workplace Technology Operations
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days onsite
Compensation: $148,000 to $158,000 base plus 20% bonus
Key Requirement: Must have experience managing a third-party MSP, ideally within a large enterprise environment.

POSITION SUMMARY
Lead enterprise workplace technology and End User Services delivered through an external MSP. This role oversees service desk, endpoint management, desktop engineering, collaboration tools, field support, employee onboarding and offboarding, and workplace technology modernization.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own the workplace technology strategy, roadmap, service portfolio, and modernization priorities.
  • Manage MSP performance, service delivery, SLAs, KPIs, escalations, demand, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Copilot, Intune, endpoint technologies, and collaboration platforms.
  • Lead endpoint architecture, engineering, service management, asset management, and employee technology support.
  • Partner with HR, Security, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Infrastructure, and business teams on technology delivery and controls.
  • Manage incidents, problems, change requests, production issues, root cause analysis, and service documentation.
  • Oversee EUS risk, SOX controls, audit requirements, security standards, data protection, and remediation activity.
  • Manage EUS budgets, vendor contracts, service costs, and MSP performance against business expectations.
  • Drive automation, orchestration, technology adoption, employee productivity, and service quality improvements.
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of End User Services, End User Computing, Digital Workplace, or related enterprise technology experience.
  • 5+ years supporting large enterprise environments.
  • Direct experience managing an MSP responsible for End User Services or workplace technology.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, MFA, Citrix, Intune, MDM, Ivanti, Absolute, remote support tools, and ServiceNow.
  • Experience with ITIL incident, problem, request, and change management.
  • Experience with SOX, audit, risk, compliance, security controls, and technical documentation.
  • Strong vendor management, budgeting, stakeholder management, communication, and process improvement experience.
PREFERRED
ITIL 4 Foundation. or  Microsoft 365 Administrator certification.

job.title: Bioconjugation Lab Assistant
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lab Assistant contractor to help support the bioconjugation team in Bristol, PA.   The Lab Assistant provides support to analysts to ensure testing needs can be completed in a timely manner by maintaining lab supplies, equipment, and materials.

Position:  Lab Assistant 
Location: Bristol, PA 
Duration: 3 months 
Schedule:  M-F 7:30 - 4:30pm 
Pay:  $21-24/hr DOE 

Responsibilities
  • Performs daily checks and calibrations of equipment (e.g. balances, storage chambers).
  • Prepare cleaning solutions for laboratory use. Clean and maintain areas of the laboratory and equipment as needed.
  • Perform routine cleaning following proper procedures for equipment such as biosafety cabinets, incubators, water baths, etc.
  • Daily monitoring and restocking of laboratory supplies and chemicals; ensure proper cycling of supplies (first in first out) and monitor supply expiration dates.
  • Orders and receives samples, lab chemicals, and consumable materials/supplies; maintains inventory of received materials and ensures accuracy of information entered.

job.title: Paid Media Operations Specialist- Music Industry-OnSite
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 9 month contract opportunity, as an Paid Media Operations Specialist within the Entertainment and Music industry to join our client, Onsite, at their office in New York, New York
  • $30/hr. max hourly rate
  • Support paid media campaign operations by managing financial reconciliations, campaign readiness, data quality, and cross-functional coordination across Marketing, Media, and Finance teams.
  • 40 hours, Mon-Friday, Day time hours. Ability to work OT as necessary.
** To be considered, your current city and state must be clearly listed on your resume. Applications with incomplete location information may not be considered **

***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***

What You Will Be Doing
  • Working closely with Paid Media Strategists, Media Buyers, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional teams, this role will support campaign readiness, financial reconciliation, workflow management, and day-to-day paid media operations..
  • Support Paid Media financial operations, including monthly reconciliation, campaign spend validation, billing documentation, customer and vendor setup, discrepancy resolution, and coordination with Finance and Accounting.
  • Support Media Buyers with campaign readiness tasks, including audience creation, pixel validation, creative organization, tracking verification, and platform access.
  • Perform internal campaign reviews across baseline campaigns to ensure campaigns are set up accurately and required information is in place.
  • Review incoming Premium campaign requests for completeness and operational readiness ahead of daily team planning.
  • Validate campaign metadata, release information, payment methods, and required documentation, including Marketing Fund notes and Customer IDs.
  • Identify missing assets, links, approvals, or campaign information and coordinate with Marketing teams and other stakeholders to resolve gaps ahead of campaign planning and launch.
  • Maintain Airtable workflow accuracy by updating request statuses, validating records, monitoring operational exceptions, and ensuring campaigns progress through the workflow correctly.
  • Coordinate operational requests across Paid Media, Marketing, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Help document and standardize operational processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Other duties as capacity allows
Who You Are
  • HS Diploma or GED required, college degree strongly preferred
  • 2+ years of experience in ad operations, paid media, marketing operations, finance/billing operations, or a similar operational role, ideally within digital advertising, media, or marketing.
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Google Ads, with an understanding of campaign setup, audiences, creative requirements, tracking, and basic campaign metrics. Hands-on campaign buying experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience supporting financial processes such as monthly reconciliation, spend validation, billing/accounting workflows, and budget tracking, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Experience managing workflows and data across tools such as Airtable, Excel/Google Sheets, CRM, or database platforms, with strong attention to data and process accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to identify missing information, assets, approvals, or operational exceptions and proactively coordinate solutions across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workflows and deadlines while working effectively with Media, Marketing, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional partners in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Health Physcist
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Health Physicist for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in St. Louis, Missouri.

Job Functions

Education/Experience Requirements: Work Schedule: Will train on 1st shift and then transition to a 2nd shift 4pm - 12:30am Friday through Tuesday schedule. 

  • Support the Health Physics group to the manufacturing and support organizations for all radiation safety and other EHS related issues. 
  • Assist in the development and implementation of radiation safety programs and practices for compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as radiation safety technical advisor to product development and associated projects.
  • Develop technical basis documents for regulatory compliance, program recommendations, or changes in practice.
  • Assist with the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the Radiation Protection Program. This includes, but is not limited to, program management, metric development and tracking, and proactive corrective actions.
  • Develop, implement and manage dose and contamination reduction initiatives.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of Emergency Response Plans.
  • Develop and maintain oversight of Radiation Work Permits. 
  • Provide periodic reports and documentation materials for review by the Radiation Safety Committee and site management as necessary.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Physical Sciences (physics, chemistry, biology, etc.) or Engineering with three years of professional experience is required.  Master of Science degree in physical sciences (physics, chemistry, biology, etc.) or engineering preferred.
  • Certified Health Physicist (CHP) accreditation by the American Board of Health Physics is preferred.
  • Must possess technical background and knowledge of applicable radiation safety regulations (e.g., NRC, DOE, EPA, DOT). 
  • Experience and expertise in use of software systems used for dose assessment (e.g., CAP88, RASCAL, VARSKIN, IMBA) and radiation modeling and shielding (e.g., MicroShield, MCNP) are highly desirable.

job.title: Manufacturing Technician / Cyclotron Operator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring Manufacturing Technicians / Cyclotron Operators for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

This is an onsite, contract-to-hire opportunity with multiple openings. The team is moving quickly and is looking for candidates with hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, military electronics, industrial electronics, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, biomedical equipment, field service, controls, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience. Prior cyclotron or radiopharmaceutical experience is not required. Training is provided. Candidates must have strong hands-on technical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, reliability, and the ability to learn highly specialized equipment systems in a regulated manufacturing environment. Candidates with general electrical, mechanical, maintenance, manufacturing, or field service backgrounds may be considered if they also have direct experience troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems, automation, controls, circuit-level issues, diagnostic equipment, or complex electro-mechanical equipment.

Pay Rate: $25/hr

Schedule:
  • This is a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Current schedule is 12-hour shifts, 7 days on / 7 days off.
  • Current rotation starts Tuesday and runs through Monday.
  • Quarterly rotation between day shift and night shift required.
  • Overtime pay applies as part of this schedule.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Perform troubleshooting for cyclotron operations and support equipment.
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs of cyclotrons and support equipment.
  • Support advanced maintenance and repair activities under general direction.
  • Perform scheduled start-ups and shutdowns of cyclotrons.
  • Perform target loading, installation, and transport activities.
  • Operate and monitor cyclotrons and support systems during target irradiation.
  • Monitor cyclotrons and support systems during standby conditions.
  • Document cyclotron performance, operations data, maintenance activities, and repair work.
  • Work closely with Cyclotron Chemistry and production teams to support daily production activities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory and quality standards, including FDA, cGMP, NRC, ISO, USP, and related requirements.

Education / Experience:
  • Two-year degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Technology, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Equivalent electronics, automation, military electronics, field service, or hands-on technical training may be considered.
  • Hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, controls, industrial electronics, biomedical equipment, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, field service, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience required.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, meters, schematics, service manuals, troubleshooting procedures, or test equipment preferred.
  • Experience with circuit boards, power supplies, sensors, relays, motors, control systems, automation systems, electrical cabinets, or complex equipment diagnostics preferred.
  • Experience with PLCs, logic circuits, VFDs, RF systems, high-voltage equipment, analog/digital circuits, vacuum systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, or manufacturing equipment is a plus.
  • Experience with component-level electronics troubleshooting, soldering, bench testing, or circuit board repair is strongly preferred but not required.

job.title: Vehicle Competence Engineer
job.description:
Vehicle Competence Engineer Development Vehicles / Platform Bring-Up / Electrical Diagnostics Overview Seeking a hands-on Electrical Engineer to support platform bring-up and troubleshooting of prototype and development vehicles. The primary focus is electrical measurement, vehicle hardware diagnostics, and resolving issues involving wiring, ECUs, sensors, power distribution, and communication networks.

This is primarily an electrical troubleshooting role rather than a software development position. The ideal candidate has strong fundamentals in electrical engineering and measurement equipment, enjoys hands-on vehicle work, and is interested in expanding into software and automation over time.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support development vehicle and platform bring-up by diagnosing electrical, hardware, and communication issues.
  • Troubleshoot wiring harnesses, connectors, grounds, power distribution, ECUs, sensors, open/short circuits, voltage drops, intermittent faults, and abnormal current draw.
  • Perform hands-on measurements using oscilloscopes, multimeters, current probes/clamps, breakout boxes, and related electrical test equipment.
  • Read wiring diagrams, schematics, connector pinouts, and network topologies to isolate failures and determine root cause.
  • Diagnose CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and Automotive Ethernet issues using Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, or comparable automotive diagnostic tools.
  • Document findings, support repair verification, and collaborate with hardware, software, prototype, and vehicle engineering teams to resolve development issues.
Required Qualifications
  • Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or similar technical background.
  • 3+ years of hands-on automotive electrical, prototype vehicle, platform bring-up, validation, or diagnostic experience.
  • Strong experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters, current measurement, electrical troubleshooting, and laboratory/vehicle measurement equipment.
  • Experience diagnosing wiring harnesses, connectors, power/ground, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle electrical systems.
  • Understanding of CAN and Automotive Ethernet and familiarity with vehicle communication/diagnostic tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting mentality with the ability to independently investigate and isolate complex electrical problems.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with prototype or development vehicle bring-up, ADAS, autonomous vehicles, or automotive validation.
  • Familiarity with radar, LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, data loggers, 12V/48V systems, ECU flashing, or vehicle commissioning.
  • Interest in developing additional skills in Python, scripting, software diagnostics, and test automation.

job.title: Head of AI Platform Engineering - Execution Plane
job.description:
Head of AI Platform Engineering 


Job Details: 
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid/Onsite)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $180-$240k base plus bonus 

We are seeking a highly experienced Head of AI Platform Engineering to lead the design, development, and operation of our AI execution platform. This leader will own the execution plane that powers enterprise AI and agentic AI workloads, including model gateways, agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool invocation services, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, and production AI operations.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people management and platform strategy. You will lead engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient AI infrastructure that enables enterprise-wide adoption of AI capabilities.

What You'll Do
  • Lead and develop engineering teams responsible for AI execution and runtime platforms.
  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI execution services including model gateways, agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool gateways, and inference services.
  • Build scalable, reliable, and observable runtime systems that support production AI workloads.
  • Partner with architecture, security, data engineering, application development, and platform teams to establish reusable AI platform capabilities.
  • Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, testing practices, CI/CD automation, incident management, operational readiness, and service reliability objectives.
  • Ensure execution platforms meet enterprise security, governance, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and operational efficiency across the organization.
  • Establish best practices for deployment, monitoring, resiliency, and performance optimization of AI services.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience leading software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and developing senior technical talent.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native platforms.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for AI/ML platforms, inference services, orchestration layers, runtime environments, or production AI operations.
  • Deep understanding of modern platform architecture, APIs, data access patterns, and enterprise integration strategies.
  • Experience building highly available and low-latency services with strong observability, resiliency, and operational controls.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD practices, infrastructure automation, testing frameworks, and production support models.
  • Understanding of enterprise security principles including identity management, auditability, secrets management, least-privilege access, and environment isolation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, LLM platforms, model gateways, agent runtimes, and orchestration frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EKS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, enterprise search, and knowledge management architectures.
  • Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, AI evaluation frameworks, and inference optimization.
  • Expertise in designing multi-tenant platforms with RBAC, ABAC, workload isolation, and secure service-to-service communication.
  • Experience implementing observability solutions for AI workloads, including latency, cost attribution, tracing, safety metrics, and quality monitoring.
  • Background building reusable SDKs, platform abstractions, deployment templates, and runtime adapters.
  • Experience operating within regulated industries where security, governance, resiliency, and auditability are critical requirements.

job.title: Scientist III - Analytical Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist III, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide advanced analytical, quality, and laboratory support for pharmaceutical R&D programs focused on the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist III will independently perform analytical testing, method development and validation, laboratory investigations, technical documentation, and regulatory support while collaborating with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will bring extensive pharmaceutical R&D experience, strong analytical chemistry expertise, and a thorough understanding of FDA, ICH, cGMP, and cGLP requirements.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: 80k + ; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Independently perform analytical testing with limited or no supervision and communicate results to management within established timelines.
  • Perform testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform analytical method development, evaluation, validation, and verification utilizing HPLC, GC, and other laboratory techniques.
  • Conduct analytical testing using wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, physical testing, and other applicable techniques.
  • Operate analytical instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document all laboratory testing in accordance with Good Documentation Practices, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Write, review, and execute analytical study plans, protocols, and reports.
  • Develop and review method development, method validation, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Author technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidance documents, validation protocols, and method transfer documentation.
  • Review laboratory notebooks, instrument logbooks, calculations, and data entries for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conduct thorough laboratory investigations of Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and other aberrant analytical results.
  • Determine root causes of laboratory investigations, develop and implement appropriate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), and prepare investigation reports.
  • Review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) documentation and related analytical documents for regulatory submissions.
  • Perform gap assessments of CMC and analytical documentation and provide recommended courses of action to management.
  • Support cGMP, cGLP, and safety audits conducted by FDA, OSHA, client companies, and other regulatory organizations.
  • Maintain familiarity and compliance with applicable FDA, ICH, and other regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, and qualification of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Collaborate with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, identify and resolve issues, and communicate results.
  • Support study design and ensure analytical development and technology transfer activities are completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and established timelines.
  • Provide effective and timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other analytical reports as required.
  • Support QC data management activities, including data review and control charting.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related applications for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict adherence to laboratory compliance and safety programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional laboratory activities and responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of relevant Pharmaceutical R&D experience with demonstrated accomplishments.
  • Strong expertise in analytical chemistry principles, methodologies, and laboratory techniques.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and related analytical instrumentation.
  • Demonstrated experience with analytical method development, evaluation, validation, verification, and technology transfer.

job.title: Staff Program Manager - hybrid schedule
job.description:
Staff Program Manager contract role opportunity!
Within gaming industry!

Location: San Diego, CA OR San Mateo, CA - Hybrid schedule 
Duration: 6 month contract 
Pay Rate: $65-74/hr on W2 

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!!

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Staff Program Manager to join our Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) team. In this highly visible role, you will drive portfolio planning, operational execution, and cross-functional coordination across a complex organization. You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, PMO, and executive stakeholders to ensure portfolio initiatives are planned, executed, and tracked effectively.

This position is ideal for a senior program management professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, excels at managing multiple priorities, and can independently drive cross-functional programs from planning through execution.
What You'll Do Portfolio Planning & Execution
  • Lead the execution and coordination of portfolio planning activities, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Program Management, and other stakeholders to support planning and delivery timelines.
  • Maintain integrated project plans, schedules, trackers, action logs, and planning documentation.
  • Monitor progress against key milestones and proactively identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and issues requiring escalation.
  • Coordinate the collection and validation of resource, budget, dependency, and program planning inputs.
  • Support leadership and portfolio review sessions by preparing materials, coordinating stakeholder feedback, tracking decisions, and ensuring follow-up actions are completed.
Portfolio Operations
  • Execute Strategic Portfolio Management processes and operating rhythms, including portfolio reviews, quarterly planning activities, governance meetings, and status reporting.
  • Communicate portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action items to key stakeholders.
  • Maintain visibility into critical portfolio information and ensure plans, decisions, timelines, and reporting artifacts remain accurate and up to date.
  • Identify cross-program dependencies and facilitate alignment across teams to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support governance processes by managing required inputs, documentation, decision tracking, and action follow-through.
Program Management
  • Coordinate complex initiatives across multiple teams, creating clear workstreams, objectives, owners, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Facilitate planning sessions, working meetings, and portfolio reviews while capturing actions, decisions, and next steps.
  • Drive assigned projects and deliverables independently, leveraging strong judgment and problem-solving skills to navigate challenges.
  • Identify, assess, track, and escalate risks that could impact portfolio objectives.
  • Partner closely with Portfolio Operations leadership to execute strategic priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.
Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in Program Management, Portfolio Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • Proven success leading complex cross-functional programs and portfolio initiatives in large, matrixed organizations.
  • Advanced expertise in:
    • Portfolio planning and execution
    • Integrated program planning
    • Schedule and milestone management
    • Dependency management
    • Risk management
    • Stakeholder communication and coordination
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple high-priority initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, PMO, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong experience supporting executive leadership reviews and coordinating deliverables for strategic decision-making.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and relationship-building abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working within Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) organizations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale product, technology, or enterprise portfolios.
  • Familiarity with portfolio governance frameworks, quarterly planning processes, and executive reporting.
Why Join Us? You'll have the opportunity to influence portfolio strategy and execution across a broad range of initiatives while partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. This role offers high visibility, meaningful impact, and the opportunity to help shape how strategic work is planned and delivered across the organization.

Apply today to be part of a collaborative team driving strategic initiatives and portfolio excellence.

job.title: AI Solutioning Consultant – Microsoft Copilot Studio - Boston or Philly
job.description:
AI Solutioning Consultant – Microsoft Copilot Studio Location: Boston, MA or Philadelphia, PA
Schedule: Hybrid — 3 days onsite per week
Conversion: Potential conversion opportunity
Work Authorization: U.S. Citizens or Green Card holders only - unable to sponsor now or in the future for this role
Interview Process: Two interviews; in-person interview possible

Position Overview Our client is seeking a hands-on AI Solutioning Consultant to join its AI Enablement team. This individual will design, build, test, and refine AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform.

The consultant will work directly with business stakeholders to understand their needs, translate them into practical AI solutions, and support adoption within established governance and security standards.

This is a hands-on solution-building and consulting role. Project or program management experience is not required.

Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and test AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Build topics, prompts, actions, connectors, and workflows.
  • Use Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, and other Microsoft tools.
  • Gather requirements and assess the feasibility of Copilot-based solutions.
  • Apply prompt engineering, prompt testing, grounding, and retrieval-augmented generation techniques.
  • Connect agents to approved enterprise data sources and knowledge repositories.
  • Troubleshoot and refine agents based on testing and stakeholder feedback.
  • Create documentation, reusable templates, and development standards.
  • Guide business users and citizen developers in building agents within approved guardrails.
  • Partner with platform, security, risk, compliance, and governance teams.
  • Help define success criteria and evaluate the effectiveness of delivered solutions.
Required Qualifications
  • Five or more years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, business analysis, low-code development, automation, or a related field.
  • At least five years working with generative AI, machine learning, AI automation, or related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building agents, bots, workflows, or automations in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Power Virtual Agents.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate and working knowledge of Dataverse.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering, prompt testing, grounding, RAG, and enterprise data sources.
  • Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Microsoft associate-level certification in a relevant field, with a verifiable credential ID.
  • U.S. Citizenship or Green Card status.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in financial services, asset management, banking, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience integrating Copilot Studio with Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365, Graph connectors, or enterprise systems.
  • Experience supporting citizen developers or business users.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, and security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, or similar enterprise AI tools.
Success in This Role The successful candidate will be able to take a business idea, determine whether Copilot Studio is an appropriate solution, build and thoroughly test a working agent, and guide it toward production use within established security and governance requirements.

job.title: UM Nurse Coordinator (RN)
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Fairfield & Redding, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit www.yoh.com!

job.title: Sr. Analyst – Asset Management
job.description:
Senior Analyst – Asset Management
6+ month contract
Plano, TX (ONSITE) 
  • Must have bachelor’s in accounting and experience with SAP ERP.
  • 3+ years of experience with fixed asset accounting/lease accounting and 3-10 years of overall experience.
  • Must have Process improvement experience.
  • CPA and public accounting experience is a must have.
  • This role is currently an individual contributor position rather than a managerial or leadership role.

Requirements:
  • Support the organization's fixed asset accounting processes and procedures.
  • Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
  • Support various quarterly/annual asset confirmation activities.
  • Record and monitor asset acquisitions, transfers, and disposals.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations and accounting standards.
  • Perform regular asset valuations and depreciation calculations.
  • Review and analyze fixed asset-related financial statements and reports.
  • Prepare and present detailed fixed asset reports for management and stakeholders.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Collaborate with departments to plan and budget for capital expenditures.
  • Coordinate with IT and administrative staff to ensure proper tagging and tracking of fixed assets.
  • Handle internal and external audit requests pertaining to fixed assets.
  • Investigate and resolve any discrepancies or issues related to fixed asset management.
  • Develop and implement process improvements for fixed asset management systems.
  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of asset acquisition, capitalization, and depreciation.
  • Administer and manage lease accounting and leased asset records.
  • Maintain documentation and records related to fixed asset management policies and procedures.
 
Qualifications/(Must Haves):
  • BS/BA in accounting, with 3-10 years of work experience in accounting.
  • Must have CPA and Public accounting experience.
  • Experience with SAP ERP system experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with fixed assets and/or lease accounting.
  • Strong Analytical skills with attention to detail and completeness.
  • Motivated and dependable self-started.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Solid time management skills, ability to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and function. independently in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Production & Assembly Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production & Assembly Technician in Austin, TX. The Production & Assembly Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and ensuring the quality of NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells, fiber optic cables, and associated products in accordance with established production procedures and customer specifications. This role involves performing electrical and optical testing, troubleshooting components, maintaining production equipment, and documenting quality control results. The candidate will have a minimum four years’ experience assembly and testing of electrical/mechanical/fluid transport systems

Title: Production & Assembly Technician
Location: Austin, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm(varies)

The Production and Assembly Technician will have direct responsibility for the following:
  • Follow production procedures, and assemble NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells and associated products to JP3 specifications and/or specific customer requirements
  • Run JP3 quality test on fiber optic cables and approve for shipping
  • Perform quality assurance testing to verify performance of components, parts and assembled units
  • Build and maintain production equipment/tools
  • Perform electrical acceptance and optical testing of final assemblies
  • Create, maintain and archive all QC documentation required for production
  • Ensure that all JP3 safety guidelines are always followed and maintain a clean and orderly environment
  • Must be able to use a multimeter and be comfortable working with 120VAC.
Candidate Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Technology, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum four years’ experience assembly and testing of electrical/mechanical/fluid transport systems
  • Attention to detail, with statistical and analytical thinking
  • Ability to read and understand electrical schematics
  • Effective written and oral communication skills
  • Working knowledge of MS Office applications, engineering software and database systems
  • Common-sense understanding to carry out written, oral, or diagrammed instructions
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, results-driven, high-tech environment within a relaxed atmosphere.

job.title: Scientist II, Analytical Product Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist II, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide analytical support for pharmaceutical product development programs, helping advance the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist II will perform analytical testing, method development, validation and verification, laboratory equipment maintenance, technical documentation, and data review while collaborating with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analytical chemistry and hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, and other pharmaceutical laboratory techniques.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 per year; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform analytical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform method development, evaluation, validation, and verification using HPLC, GC, and other analytical laboratory techniques.
  • Utilize analytical techniques including wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and physical testing.
  • Perform testing using instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing according to Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze testing results and communicate findings to management in a timely manner.
  • Write, review, and execute study plans, analytical protocols, validation protocols, technical transfer protocols, and associated reports.
  • Author technical documents including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), method validation protocols/reports, and method transfer protocols/reports.
  • Review laboratory documentation, including notebooks and instrument logbooks, for calculations, data entry accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, and routine monitoring of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other laboratory reports as required.
  • Assist with analytical data management, including data review and control charting.
  • Collaborate with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, resolve technical issues, and communicate results.
  • Support the creation of study designs, method development protocols and reports, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Provide timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic pharmaceutical products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related software for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict compliance with laboratory procedures and applicable compliance programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory work environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a science-related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of three (3) to six (6) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a relevant area of Pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Strong knowledge of basic analytical chemistry principles and techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation and techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, chromatography, and spectrometry.
  • Experience with analytical method development, validation, verification, and/or method transfer.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D environments, terminology, procedures, and regulatory expectations.
  • Knowledge of Good Documentation Practices and laboratory compliance requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing analytical protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar programs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to organize and manage analytical activities while meeting established project timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate laboratory documentation and data integrity.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Licensed Mental Health Clinician
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Licensed Mental Health Clinician for a contract assignment with a respected client located in Newark, NJ. The Clinician will deliver comprehensive behavioral health services to students, including intake assessments, individual and group therapy, crisis response services, and evaluations to assess mental health risks and support student well-being.

**NJ Applicable Licenses: LPC, LCSW, LMFT, LCADC, or Psychologist

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 month contract with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $40-62/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Diagnoses and assesses counseling and treatment needs and conducts crisis assessments, interventions, and management for distressed students
  • Provides hands-on case management for on- and off-campus referrals, monitors students of concern, and participates in discharge planning
  • Requires knowledge and experience of psychotherapy, the ability to operate within systems, and the ability to develop a database of viable and appropriate mental health resources for various levels of care (e.g. outpatient, inpatient, intensive outpatient, etc)
  • Provides ethical and responsible treatment of students by prioritizing completing administrative tasks, including intake assessments, treatment plan reviews, progress notes, crisis notes, and discharge summaries
  • Engages with the campus community including providing outreach, consultation, and educational services as requested.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Master’s Degree in mental health discipline plus two (2) years post Master’s experience in the mental health field including delivering psychotherapeutic services to the identified population, or a Doctorate Degree.
  • Independent license to practice as required by New Jersey state laws governing the discipline (LPC, LCSW, LMFT, LCADC, Licensed Psychologist).

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).
 

Estimated Min Rate: $105000.00
Estimated Max Rate: $150000.00

job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!
Engineering Technician – Semiconductor Manufacturing
Applied Materials | Gloucester, Massachusetts
PAY RANGE: $30.00 - $32.00 PER HOUR (Depending on Experience)
Plus Applicable Shift Differentials Available Shifts 1rst Shift:  5:30 pm – 4:00 pm (Monday through Thursday)
2nd Shift: 3:45 PM – 2:15 AM | +10% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
3rd Shift: 7:30 PM – 6:00 AM + 13% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
4th Shift: 5:45 AM – 6:15 PM | +11% Differential (Friday, Saturday and Sunday) Why This Opportunity? Are you a hands-on Engineering Technician who thrives in a fast-paced semiconductor production environment? Do you enjoy building, testing, and troubleshooting complex electro-mechanical systems? This is an opportunity to work on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and support cutting-edge technology. Why Applied Materials?
  • Global leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and technology.
  • Technology that powers AI, smartphones, automotive systems, medical devices and next-generation innovation.
  • Strong history of contractor-to-permanent employee conversions.
  • Work directly with advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems.
  • Excellent career growth and advancement opportunities.
What You Will Do
  • Perform electro-mechanical testing, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly.
  • Build and support electronics, electro-mechanical systems, prototype models and specialized test equipment.
  • Troubleshoot component-level and system-level electrical and mechanical issues.
  • Support new system installs, NPI activities and field upgrades.
  • Work from schematics, diagrams, layouts and technical instructions.
  • Maintain logbooks, technical documentation and test procedures.
  • Perform electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process testing.
  • Generate quality notifications and complete rework based on test results.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering activities.
Required Technical Skills
  • Hands-on manufacturing or production experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process systems.
  • Experience with hand tools and power tools.
  • Ability to read schematics, assembly drawings and engineering documentation.
  • Experience with electrical test equipment, meters and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of fiber-optic communications.
  • Ability to write technical reports and procedures.
  • Semiconductor manufacturing experience preferred.
Mechanical Skills Required
  • Strong build, assembly and fabrication skills with experience using precision measuring devices.
Nice To Have
  • Experience with PMAC motion control systems.
Why You Will Want This Role
  • Hands-on work with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex systems.
  • Opportunity to support engineering innovation and NPI efforts.
  • A role where your technical skills truly make an impact.
Why Work Through Yoh?
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Weekly Direct Deposit and ePayroll
  • Employee Discount Programs
  • Dedicated Yoh Support Team

job.title: Human Resources - Recruiter / Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter - Remote
job.description:
Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter (Remote - U.S.)
Location: Remote (Continental United States)
Pay Rate: $35-$42 hourly W2
Duration: 6 months contract 


Work Hours: Must be available during Eastern Time business hours

Are you passionate about finding and engaging top technology talent? We are seeking a Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter to serve as a strategic talent advisor and sourcing expert focused on identifying exceptional professionals across Cloud, Software Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, and Architecture disciplines.
In this role, you will drive proactive talent strategies, build high-quality candidate pipelines, and provide valuable market intelligence that supports long-term workforce planning. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced technology sourcing professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys uncovering hard-to-find talent.


What You'll Do:
• Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify top technology talent across Cloud, Software Engineering, Data, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Architecture disciplines.
• Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, with a focus on both active and passive candidates.
• Conduct talent mapping and competitive intelligence research to identify target companies, key talent pools, and emerging technology skill sets.
• Partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and business leaders to understand workforce plans and establish sourcing strategies aligned to business priorities.
• Utilize advanced search techniques, social platforms, networking, referrals, and industry events to engage high-demand technical talent.
• Perform initial candidate outreach, engagement, and qualification conversations to assess technical background, career motivations, and alignment with business needs.
• Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring activity, and emerging technology skills.
• Partner with Diversity Strategy teams to develop diverse candidate pipelines and expand access to underrepresented technology talent.
• Track and report sourcing activity, pipeline health, market insights, and candidate engagement metrics.
• Continuously evaluate and recommend innovative sourcing tools, technologies, and practices to improve talent identification efforts.

What You'll Bring:
• 8+ years of technology sourcing and recruiting experience, with a strong focus on attracting talent in Cloud Engineering, Software Development, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, and Architecture domains.
• Bachelor's degree required.
• Demonstrated success sourcing passive technology talent in highly competitive and niche markets.
• Expertise in talent mapping, competitive intelligence, market research, and advanced sourcing methodologies.
• Strong experience leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter, talent intelligence platforms, applicant tracking systems, and sourcing analytics.
• Deep understanding of technology skill sets, organizational structures, and talent trends across the technology landscape.
• Ability to build credibility and influence hiring leaders through data-driven talent insights and market expertise.
• Exceptional networking, relationship-building, and candidate engagement skills.

job.title: Azure Systems Engineer
job.description:
Azure Systems Engineer (IaC/Terraform) — Azure Infrastructure + Automation
Location: McKinney, TX (Hybrid)
Type: 6-month Contract-to-Hire (W2 only; no C2C)

Overview
This role blends hands-on operational support and project delivery to keep core cloud platforms stable, secure, and scalable. You’ll focus heavily on Azure infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Azure networking, and PowerShell automation, while partnering with DevOps to improve release readiness and production supportability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide operational support for production Azure environments, acting as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and driving root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Build, enhance, and standardize Azure infrastructure using Terraform (IaC) to support repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
  • Support and troubleshoot Azure networking (e.g., VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, DNS, connectivity) and resolve network-related incidents impacting services.
  • Identify repeatable tasks and reduce operational toil using PowerShell automation (scripts, tooling, runbook-style workflows).
  • Partner with DevOps/engineering to support CI/CD and release workflows (Azure DevOps/Jenkins or similar), ensuring deployments are tested, documented, and operationally ready.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring/observability using tools such as Azure Monitor, Splunk, Dynatrace (or similar) to improve reliability and reduce time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
  • Ensure runbooks/SOPs, validation steps, and support documentation are in place prior to production releases.
  • Assist with internal/external audits, evidence collection, remediation efforts, and adherence to security/regulatory standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related) or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years in Systems Engineering / Infrastructure / IT Operations
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting Azure in production
  • Strong Terraform experience building/managing cloud infrastructure as code
  • Strong PowerShell scripting/automation experience
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Splunk, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, etc.)
  • Solid networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing) and strong troubleshooting skills
  • Proven ability to document, create runbooks, and support production operations
