job.title: Land Survey Crew Chief - Fort Lauderdale, FL
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Survey Crew Chief to oversee survey operations for our Civil Engineering client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of overall surveying experience, prior experience as a Crew Chief, and live within a commutable distance to the office Fort Lauderdale, FL for an onsite environment.

 


See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

 

Title: Land Survey Crew Chief

Compensation: $30.00-$40.00/hour (depending on experience level)

Type: Full Time

Industry: Civil Engineering

 

Responsibilities:

·      Lead field operations using advanced equipment such as Trimble, Leica, and Spectre robotic total stations, GPS RTK Units, and 3D Laser Scanners.

·      Manage data collection efficiently, ensuring seamless transfer and collaboration with office staff.

·      Maintain accurate documentation and organization of project files upon completion.

·      Utilize map interpretation skills to navigate projects effectively, including scaling drawings and deciphering symbols.

·      Guide the team with your comprehensive knowledge of survey types and their purposes.

·      Foster open communication with the Assistant/Project Manager and team members to address project needs promptly.

·      Take responsibility for equipment maintenance, ensuring optimal performance for each project.

·      Demonstrate initiative in optimizing task execution to enhance efficiency and productivity.

·      Utilize general computer applications proficiently to streamline surveying processes.

·      Embrace opportunities for growth and development through training and educational initiatives.

·      Be flexible to work overtime and travel with overnight stays as required by project demands.

·      Contribute your insights and creativity to our team culture, driving innovation and collaboration.

·      Demonstrate reliability and punctuality, essential qualities for success in this role.



 

Qualifications:

·      5+ years of surveying experience in AutoCAD Civil 3D, with demonstrated proficiency in producing clean and accurate plan presentations and 1 to 2 years of Florida construction experience

·      Strong math skills to ensure precise measurement and calculation in surveying tasks.

·      Proven record of producing clean and accurate plan presentations, showcasing attention to detail and quality.

·      Knowledge of field survey operations, as well as the engineering and construction industry, to effectively coordinate survey activities with project requirements.

·      Excellent organizational and communication skills, facilitating effective collaboration with team members and clients.

·      Ability to learn new software and technologies in a timely manner, adapting to evolving industry tools and methodologies.

·      Proficient with MS Word and Excel, enabling efficient documentation and data management processes.

job.title: Intermediate/Advanced Warehouse Materials Coordinator
job.description:
Intermediate/Advanced Materials Coordinator needed for an 12-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate $23 to $28 per hour depending on experience
 



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change



What You Will Be Doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Prioritize daily activities within the Stockroom and Materials department to support production schedules and customer requirements.
  • Provide support at the Westford offsite warehouse as needed, including order picking and general materials coverage.
  • Investigate order picking issues, inventory discrepancies, cycle count variances, and nonconforming material. Perform cycle counts to verify inventory accuracy and maintain inventory integrity.
  • Locate, audit, transfer, and stage kits or materials to support production and shipping requirements.
  • Receive incoming materials, complete inventory transactions, and update inventory records, shortage reports, and related documentation using Made2Manage (M2M) or other inventory systems.
  • Monitor and maintain shortage reports to help ensure material availability for production.
  • Coordinate the processing and disposition of nonconforming material in accordance with established procedures.
  • Work with management to minimize excess inventory by relocating, consolidating, or disposing of material as directed.
  • Organize, consolidate, and maintain stockroom locations to maximize storage capacity, improve inventory accuracy, and support efficient material flow.
  • Assist with expediting material deliveries from suppliers when requested by management.
  • Train and certify Material Coordinators on departmental processes, procedures, and safe work practices.
  • Follow established business processes and maintain accurate documentation for inventory and material transactions.
  • Support inventory control initiatives by identifying excess or obsolete material and assisting with rework, transfer, or scrap activities as directed.
  • Operate powered industrial equipment, including pallet jacks, electric pallet jacks, after certification.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures and actively contribute to maintaining a safe work environment.
  • Provide cross functional coverage for Inventory Control, Receiving, the Stockroom, and Production Control during planned or unplanned absences.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • This position requires the ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday. Regular physical activity includes bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting materials, and working in confined spaces.
  • The role also requires the ability to distinguish between colors, work in a manufacturing environment with varying noise levels, use hand and power tools, and safely operate powered industrial equipment, including forklifts.
  • Some work may be performed in a clean room environment. When required, employees must wear appropriate personal protective equipment, which may include coveralls, hoods, boot covers, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, face shields, and other required protective equipment.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in stockroom operations, inventory control, material handling, and established departmental procedures.
  • Applies standard processes and sound judgment to complete assigned responsibilities accurately and efficiently.
  • Understands how the Materials department supports Manufacturing, Planning, Purchasing, Shipping, Receiving, and other operational functions.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Outlook and has basic to intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Comfortable working within ERP and inventory management systems, including Made2Manage (M2M).
  • Provides day to day guidance and support to less experienced team members.
  • Assists with training, onboarding, and certification of Material Coordinators while promoting consistent work practices.
  • Investigates inventory and material related issues, identifies root causes, and resolves routine and moderately complex problems by applying established procedures and sound judgment.
  • Escalates issues appropriately when additional support or direction is needed.
  • Communicates effectively with Planning, Production, Inventory Control, Receiving, Shipping, Purchasing, and other departments to ensure material availability and resolve issues.
  • Builds positive working relationships and maintains clear, professional communication





Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Overall Years of experience -2-4
  • Mandatory Skills: Technical/Non-Technical

Days/Shift Hours: 
Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour shifts.
6PM-6AM.

job.title: Senior / Lead Technical Program Manager – Vehicle Level Software Integration & Test
job.description:
Senior / Lead Technical Program Manager – Vehicle Level Software Integration & Test
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior/Lead Technical Program Manager to lead vehicle-level software integration and test activities across complex, multi-domain vehicle programs. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, systems engineering, and vehicle program management — responsible for orchestrating the integration and validation of software from multiple domains (e.g., ADAS, infotainment, body controls, thermals, motion and powertrain, connectivity, cybersecurity) into a cohesive, validated vehicle-level software release. The TPM will define verification & validation (V&V) strategy for new features, drive execution across the full test hierarchy (pre-merge through vehicle-level), plan and manage vehicle test trips, and ensure the software test fleet is ready to execute — while managing schedule, risk, and cross-functional alignment to ensure software quality, safety, and timely delivery.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
  • 7+ years of experience in software program/project management, systems integration, or V&V, with significant time in automotive or embedded/vehicle software environments.
  • Proven experience creating and executing V&V plans for software features across the full test hierarchy (unit, pre-merge, post-merge, HIL/SIL, vehicle-level).
  • Experience planning and/or supporting vehicle test trips (e.g., winter test, hot weather test) and managing test fleet logistics and readiness.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle software architecture (ECUs, domain controllers, in-vehicle networks such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SOA-based architectures).
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional software integration and test programs with multiple interdependent workstreams.
  • Familiarity with SDLC, Agile/SAFe methodologies, and CI/CD-based test automation for embedded systems.
  • Excellent risk management, prioritization, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to translate technical complexity into clear program status for leadership.
  • Proficiency with program management and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project) and defect/test management systems (e.g., ALM, Polarion).
  • Strong analytical, data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to test sites/trip locations as required.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434) V&V requirements.
  • Experience with software-defined vehicle (SDV) architectures, OTA update systems, and CI/CD for embedded systems.
  • Experience managing seasonal/climate-based test programs (e.g., winter test in northern climates, hot weather test) including fleet mobilization at remote proving grounds.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), or similar certification.
  • Experience working with global, cross-site engineering teams and Tier 1 suppliers.
  • Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python, shell) for test/integration tooling.
Key Competencies
  • Systems-level thinking with strong technical fluency across hardware-software boundaries
  • Executive-level communication and influence without direct authority
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity across complex, matrixed organizations
  • Strong ownership mindset and bias for action under tight program timelines
  • Strong logistics and cross-functional coordination skills, particularly for time- and location-bound test events

Key Responsibilities
Integration & Program Management
  • Own the end-to-end vehicle-level software integration and test plan, aligning domain-level software delivery schedules with vehicle program milestones (e.g., SOP, Job 1, integration builds, validation events).
  • Coordinate across software domain teams (ADAS, HMI/infotainment, body & chassis, powertrain, connected services, cybersecurity, OTA) to ensure compatible interfaces, dependencies, and release readiness.
  • Coordinate Systems Engineering activities across vehicle domains and organizations to ensure integration requirements are consistently defined and understood.
  • Partner with hardware teams to track ECU/component availability and hardware pedigree, ensuring integration and test schedules account for hardware readiness.
  • Drive the software build and integration cadence, managing bill-of-software (BOS) configurations, release trains, and version control across ECUs/domain controllers.
  • Manage program-level dashboards, metrics, and reporting on integration health, software maturity, defect burn-down, and readiness for key gate reviews.
  • Facilitate technical reviews and readiness assessments (e.g., Integration Readiness Review, Test Readiness Review, Release Readiness Review) with engineering leadership and program stakeholders.
  • Identify and mitigate schedule, technical, and resource risks; escalate proactively with clear options and recommendations.
  • Interface with suppliers and Tier 1 partners on software delivery timing, quality, and integration commitments; manage supplier relationships for software/firmware components, ensuring clear requirements and timely deliveries.
Verification & Validation (V&V) Planning
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive V&V plans for new features and functions, defining acceptance criteria, test coverage, entry/exit criteria, and traceability from requirements through validation.
  • Partner with feature teams, systems engineering, and safety/cybersecurity teams to ensure V&V plans address functional, performance, safety (ISO 26262), and security (ISO/SAE 21434) requirements.
  • Define the test strategy across the full validation hierarchy — unit, pre-merge, post-merge (integration), HIL/SIL bench, and vehicle-level — ensuring appropriate coverage and traceability at each stage.
  • Establish and evolve V&V processes, templates, and governance to scale across concurrent feature workstreams and vehicle programs.
Test Execution Oversight
  • Plan and oversee execution of pre-merge testing (automated gating checks/CI pipelines) to ensure code quality and prevent regression prior to integration.
  • Plan and oversee execution of post-merge/integration testing across domain and cross-domain builds, ensuring timely defect detection and closure before promotion to vehicle-level test.
  • Plan and oversee execution of vehicle-level validation (bench, proving ground, fleet/field testing), coordinating test resources, vehicle availability, and cross-functional support teams.
  • Drive triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution of defects found across all test phases; lead cross-functional defect review boards and daily stand-ups.
  • Track V&V execution metrics (test pass rate, coverage, defect density/aging, escape rate) and report progress and risk to program leadership.
  • Triage defects surfaced from vehicle testing outside the core SIT process — including durability/mileage accumulation, driver fleet testing, and other vehicle test organizations — and coordinate scheduling of fixes with the relevant software domain teams.
  • Partner with software domain teams to build and maintain release checklists, and own release notes for vehicle-level software releases, including documentation of known limitations and workarounds
  • Continuously improve test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling to increase efficiency and coverage across pre-merge, post-merge, and vehicle-level test stages.
Test Trip Planning & Fleet Readiness
  • Plan and manage dedicated vehicle test trips (e.g., winter/cold-climate testing, hot weather/desert testing, high-altitude, durability, and other geographically/environmentally driven validation events), including scope definition, scheduling, logistics, and staffing.
  • Define test trip objectives and exit criteria in coordination with feature and V&V teams, ensuring trip test plans map back to overall software release and validation milestones.
  • Coordinate cross-functional trip logistics — vehicle allocation, travel/site arrangements, tooling/data-logging equipment, and on-site support — partnering with fleet operations, hardware, and facilities teams.
  • Oversee test readiness of the software test vehicle fleet, ensuring vehicles are built with the correct software configuration/BOS, instrumentation, and known-issue status prior to trip departure or test execution.
  • Establish and run fleet readiness reviews/checklists (software load verification, calibration status, defect triage for known issues, safety sign-off) prior to key test events.
  • Track fleet health and availability throughout test trips, managing real-time issue triage, software patch/update deployment to vehicles in the field, and escalation of blocking issues.
  • Capture and report test trip results, lessons learned, and residual risk back into the broader V&V and program risk tracking process.

job.title: Lab Support Engineer
job.description:
Lab Support Engineer
We are seeking a hands-on Lab Support Engineer to support hardware testing, lab automation, robotics, and reliability activities within an engineering development environment. This role combines electro-mechanical testing with LabVIEW/Python automation, data acquisition, automated test systems, and day-to-day lab operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across hardware and software and can troubleshoot complex test setups while supporting multiple development programs.

Scope:
• Set up, configure, and execute hardware reliability, environmental, mechanical, and stress testing.
• Develop, maintain, and execute automated test routines and DAQ sequences using LabVIEW, Python, C++, or similar tools.
• Integrate, program, and troubleshoot robotic fixtures, actuators, PLCs, and automated test stations.
• Configure sensors, instrumentation, drivers, firmware, and network connections supporting laboratory equipment.
• Operate test equipment including thermal/humidity chambers, vibration systems, Instron testers, oscilloscopes, DMMs, DAQs, and related instrumentation.
• Troubleshoot test anomalies, sensor issues, automation failures, and equipment problems.
• Support hardware testing throughout EVT, DVT, and PVT development phases.
• Analyze test data and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate results.
• Develop and maintain SOPs, test procedures, work instructions, and automation documentation.
• Support lab operations including equipment calibration, safety, test-cell organization, and maintenance.

Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of experience in hardware testing, lab automation, instrument control, reliability testing, or test bench development.
• Hands-on experience with LabVIEW for instrument control, sensor interfacing, or automated data acquisition.
• Experience with robotics or automation systems such as robotic arms, linear actuators, PLCs, motor controllers, or automated fixtures.
• Experience with environmental, mechanical, or reliability testing using equipment such as thermal chambers, vibration tables, or Instron systems.
• Experience with electrical instrumentation including oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, sensors, thermocouples, and DAQ systems.
• Experience with Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar scripting/programming tools.
• Strong troubleshooting, data analysis, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings and work hands-on with electro-mechanical test setups.

Pluses:
• CLAD, CLD, or other LabVIEW certification.
• 5+ years of experience with lab automation, robotics, or reliability testing.
• Experience developing custom LabVIEW/Python test GUIs or automated test benches.
• Experience integrating test systems with databases or dashboards.
• Familiarity with RS-232/485, CAN, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, GPIB, I2C, SPI, or similar communication protocols.
• Experience supporting fast-paced hardware development and EVT/DVT/PVT environments.

job.title: Prototype Vehicle Technician
job.description:
Prototype Vehicle Technician

The Prototype Vehicle Technician supports engineering development and testing by maintaining, upgrading, and modifying test vehicles. This role performs component removal and replacement, interprets wiring and harness diagrams, follows engineering instructions, and uses Linux and basic shell scripts to support vehicle setup and troubleshooting.

What you’ll be able to do: 
  • Perform vehicle component removal and replacement (R&R) to support engineering development and testing.
  • Install and modify mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems according to engineering instructions.
  • Read and interpret wiring diagrams, harness schematics, connector pinouts, and technical procedures.
  • Safely operate hand tools, power tools, diagnostic equipment, and garage machinery.
  • Assist with basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, reporting findings to engineers.
  • Use Linux systems and run basic shell scripts for vehicle setup and diagnostics.
  • Document completed work, configuration changes, and identified issues.
  • Maintain an organized, safe workspace and comply with all garage procedures.
  • Adapt to changing priorities while working independently and collaborating with engineering teams.
  • Ability to track work through Jira and other Atlassian tools.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of electrical principles and automotive standards.

Minimum requirements: 
(one or more of the following)
  • Degree or Certification in Automotive Technology
  • 2+ years of experience as an Automotive Technician 
  • 2+ year of experience in a factory setting launching new products

Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Hands-on experience building and launching automotive products and vehicle prototyping  
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Confluence, and Jira applications 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • An eagerness to work in a fast paced cross-functional environment
  • Understanding of high voltage safety practices and demonstrated capability to work in a high voltage environment
  • Ability to travel and work flexible hours as needed to support road trips, test facilities, and proving ground activities.

job.title: Technical Program Manager – Chassis Firmware Integration
job.description:
Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
 
As Technical Program Manager, you will use your technical expertise to holistically drive complex problems to completion. You will work with the team to scope work, plan requirements, identify risks, estimate budgets, and clearly communicate ongoing progress.
Seeking an experienced Software Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Powertrain and Motion Controls. The TPM will be responsible for driving the team to meet their committed deliverables as well as working with the engineers, technical leads, and managers across the broader organization to assess risk, communicate status, and drive closure to key issues. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in automotive powertrain systems and motion controls, excellent project management skills, and experience working with highly cross-functional teams. This environment is not for everyone but will enrich the best talent with the opportunity to perform some of the best work of their careers. 

Responsibilities:
As a technical program manager, you will be a force multiplier and enable a world-class team of engineers to execute with quality and under aggressive development timelines.
You will be responsible for the following domains: powertrain and motion controls.
Your responsibilities include the following:
  • Coordinate with various controls, systems, and integration engineers to establish feature delivery roadmaps, define key deliverable delivery dates, and tie deliverables to engineering milestones.
  • Work Right-to-Left to ensure that the vehicle and motor torque controls development plans meet end-user needs, support hardware and system DV test plans, and meet engineering program milestones.
  • Coordinate with vehicle program management on prototype vehicle and test asset allocation. Ensure engineers have the resources that they need, at the time that they need it, to complete their testing and validation.
  • Run sprint planning sessions and help organize the engineering task workflow.
  • Track sprint action items and progress towards engineering deliverables. Report status to engineering management and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Work with engineering management to assess team workload management and vocalize resource gaps.
  • Assist engineering to prioritize work tasks and ensure team progress.
  • Set the overall sprint timeline, identify and resolve roadblocks.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years program management experience, with focus on automotive powertrain systems software development, verification and validation, or quality assurance
  • Product launch experience with a vehicle OEM in systems, software, or testing
  • Experience with automotive powertrain systems is required
  • Experience working with vehicle motion controls
  • Experience working with vehicle diagnostics
  • Experience with Agile Methodology, CI/CD is required
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Las Vegas - Weekday/Monday-Friday/Moonlight
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - Las Vegas - Weekday/Monday-Friday/Moonlight

Shift Days/Hours: 
Monday-Friday, 8-hour shifts.
10PM-6:30AM. 

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements, and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive parts specialist, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Experienced in positions such as – parts advisor, parts specialist, inventory technician, materials handlers, parts coordinator, etc.
• Experience with a DMS (Dealer Management System) – CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, etc. (SAP experience would be great but not required).
• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Contract Manufacturing Tech (Semiconductor)
job.description:
We have long-term contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $23.00 to $25.00/Hr.
Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Analyst
job.description:
Title::  Senior IT Infrastructure Analyst
Location:  Jersey City, NJ
Type: Hybrid ( 3 days onsite)
Terms - 3 Months Contract to Hire
Pay Rate:  $50/hr-$55/hr
Salary: $95K-$120K base+ 10% Bonus
                  

The team is looking to add a Level 2/Level 3 Windows Desktop Administrator to support a rapidly growing user base that has more than doubled over the past year.
The role is heavily focused on supporting Windows 11 laptops, Citrix-hosted VDI, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365.

The individual will serve as the primary point of contact for endpoint issues, troubleshoot problems, perform deployments, onboard and offboard users, and escalate infrastructure issues to specialized teams when necessary.
 
Must-Have Technical Skills
  • Strong experience supporting Windows 11 desktops and laptops.
  • Hands-on administration and support of Microsoft Intune (device deployment, Autopilot, endpoint management, onboarding/offboarding).
  • Experience supporting Citrix Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
  • Microsoft 365/Exchange Online administration and support.
  • Level 2/Level 3 desktop troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience deploying and provisioning endpoint devices.
  • Ability to recognize when issues require escalation to infrastructure teams.
 
Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Intune engineering and application deployment experience.
  • PowerShell scripting (preferred, not required).
  • Understanding of Active Directory and Group Policy (GPO).
  • Experience supporting developer workstations and development tools.
  • Mobile device management for iPhones, iPads, and Android devices through Intune.
  • Experience migrating on-premises VDI environments to cloud-based solutions (future initiative).
  • Familiarity with endpoint security platforms (vendor experience is transferable).
 
Soft Skills They Are Looking For
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Comfortable supporting everyone from executives and C-level leadership to end users.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in a small team.
  • Adaptable with a willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Calm under pressure during mission-critical production issues.
  • Follows documented procedures and delivers consistent solutions.

Mainframe Developer - Onsite, Dallas TX area - W2 Only

Develop, test, and support complex mainframe applications using COBOL, DB2, CICS, JCL, and VSAM. job.title: NE Administrative Operations & Support Manager
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Administrative Operations & Support Manager opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

If you don't wish to receive these mails, just turn off "Job expiry email alerts" inside the user profile or system settings.

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
They will be required to assist in making sure that Yoh employees enter their time as required.
Have knowledge of HR process and procedures and work with Yoh HR and Employee Relations.

job.title: Jr Mechanical Test Technician
job.description:
Mechanical Test Technician

Looking for a Jr mechanical tester to test, troubleshoot, & inspect consumer electronics in a HW R&D lab environment. This person should have an understanding of HW evaluation methodologies, including development of test cases/suites, fixture and mockup design, performance monitoring, and data analysis. They will collaborate with engineers & technicians to produce timely and quality testing results in the development of products.

 

Required:

• Experience with mechanical testing & inspections specifically on consumer electronics in an R&D lab environment.

• Experience using mechanical lab & machine shop equipment and tools: Laser cutters, band saws, drill presses, Instrons, drop towers, high speed cams, DAQs, power supplies, DMMs.

• Experience setting up tests & instrumentation for data collection & reporting.

• Proficiency with NX CAD SW.

• Proficiency with Google software suite - Sheets, Docs, Drive, Meet.

• Ability to work from schematics, CAD drawings, rough engineering drawings and/or verbal instruction.

• Meticulous and discerning eye for optical measurements.

• Proactive team player with good follow-through and the ability to accept critical feedback, working on tasks semi autonomously after some training & experience.

• Flexibility to perform tests in multiple testing environments that may involve electrical, mechanical, thermal, etc.

 

Pluses:

• Knowledge of LabVIEW programming and NI equipment.

• Strong theoretical background in the mechanics of solids and electrical circuits.

• Experience using digital and laser scanning microscopes and OMMs: shape analysis, surface roughness, flatness, profile, & tolerance measurements.

• Experience creating unit test plans.

job.title: mRNA Pilot Plant lab- Team Associate II
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term mRNA Pilot Plant Associate opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. The client is seeking a highly motivated and scientifically rigorous individual to join the Plasmid Production Pilot team. You will focus on execution and scale-up of a robust pDNA production process focusing on bacterial cell lysis, supercoiled plasmid DNA linearization, and purification for preclinical linearized plasmid DNA production, with the ultimate goal of transferring at scale methods to either the internal or external manufacturing team for mRNA drug substance with applications towards vaccine development.
 

  • Evaluate, and implement purification technology and optimize existing techniques and workflows.
  • Support the execution and optimization of plasmid DNA purification, problem solving.
  • Design and execute decision-quality research; prepare/draft SOPs, technical reports, batch record, and presentations to management and other stakeholders.
  • Work independently, pro-actively, and be an impactful contributor to project teams. Function in highly collaborative cross functional teams.
  • Execute ~20 batches per year.
  • This will be primarily a lab-based position.

Qualifications
  • BS with 1-3 years or MS with 0-2 years of relevant industrial experience in a related field (e.g. biochemistry, chemistry, chemical or biomedical engineering) for Senior Research Associate role.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in small and large scale plasmid DNA extraction and purification methodologies including alkali lysis, chromatography separation (anion exchange, hydrophobic interaction) and buffer exchange methods. Familiar with Cytiva AKTA Pilot and Ready system and Repligen TFF system (K2Ri and KMPi) are preferred.
  • Prepare buffers for purification process.
  • Familiar with equipment setup, process troubleshooting and maintenance and experience in GLP environment is advantageous.
  • Works collaboratively within group for improved operational excellence as well as within interdisciplinary teams.
  • Desire to work in a team-first, fast-paced environment, learn new technologies and skills, and to efficiently solve problems.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Attention to detail & meticulous record keeping.
  • Demonstrate continuous growth in depth and breadth of personal scientific knowledge and understanding of strategic goals of group, team, and company

job.title: Quality Control Analyst II - Onsite, Mansfield, MA
job.description:
Analyst II, Quality Control Operations
Overview
The Quality Control Technical Operations Analyst II supports quality and compliance activities from development through commercialization. In addition to performing routine and non-routine testing, this position may participate in data trending, investigations, laboratory operations, method transfers, method qualification and validation, verification, and implementation.
By ensuring these activities are completed accurately and within established timelines, the Analyst II contributes to efficient and effective quality control operations.
This position is onsite and will be primarily located in Norton, MA, with occasional responsibilities at a secondary location in Cambridge, MA.
Key Responsibilities
• Perform routine and non-routine analytical assays of increasing complexity to support raw materials, in-process samples, product release, and stability studies in accordance with established SOPs.
• Maintain current training records, follow testing schedules, and complete assignments on time to support laboratory operations and project timelines.
• Assist with laboratory equipment and inventory maintenance, including the preparation of reagents and samples.
• Submit data accurately and on time. May qualify as a data reviewer to support timely and efficient data availability.
• Perform role-specific operational assignments, such as raw material sampling and testing, environmental monitoring, and product testing.
• Contribute to the revision and updating of controlled documents, including SOPs, work instructions, and test methods.
• Follow internal policies, procedures, SOPs, and applicable regulatory and industry standards, including GMP, GLP, and ICH guidelines.
• Collaborate with Quality Control and cross-functional teams to support effective laboratory and quality control operations.
• Pursue ongoing training and professional development related to QC testing techniques and regulatory compliance.
• Assist with data verification for regulatory submissions, as needed.
• Participate in inspection readiness activities and support onsite audits and inspections, as needed.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance QC processes, laboratory efficiency, and overall effectiveness.
• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Materials Management, Quality Assurance, and other organizational functions to support business and quality objectives.
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, or a related scientific field. An associate degree, biotechnology certificate, or equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
• Four to eight years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, a regulated laboratory setting, Quality Control, or a related field.
• Data analysis experience preferred.
• Ability to work under direction with strong attention to detail in an environment where priorities may shift.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.
• Familiarity with LIMS, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is helpful.

job.title: Procurement Auditor
job.description:
Temporary part-time Procurement Auditor 

***** Candidate needs to be able to start asap *****
***** Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!!

  • Work Schedule: This is a part-time role ~20 hours per week for 8-10 weeks ?9AM - 4PM Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
  • Location: 2 of the 3 days onsite or can be remote, preferred to have someone go onsite though. 1135 Tremont Street, Boston
  • Duration:  10 weeks (potential to extend to 12-14 weeks)
  • Pay Rate: $35-42/hr on W2 

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented, part-time temporary team member to support a supplier data audit project. This role involves reviewing existing supplier profiles for accuracy, updating payment terms, reviewing supplier contracts, and helping identify and confirm suppliers eligible for an upcoming virtual card payment program. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently with structured data and contract documents, has strong attention to detail, and can communicate professionally with internal stakeholders and, where needed, suppliers.


Key Responsibilities

• Audit existing supplier profiles in Jaggaer Supplier Management and Workday Finance for completeness and accuracy of key fields (contact information, tax ID, banking details, payment terms, etc.)

• Review current payment terms for each supplier and update records to reflect negotiated or standardized terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60)

• Review supplier contracts to verify that payment terms, pricing, and key terms on file match the executed agreement

• Identify contracts that are expired, missing, or due for renewal, and flag any discrepancies between contract terms and system records

• Flag discrepancies, missing data, or outdated information for follow-up with internal stakeholders or suppliers

• Contact suppliers directly, as needed, to obtain corrected or missing information and update supplier profiles to resolve identified issues

• Ensure updates to supplier profiles and payment terms are accurately reflected and synchronized across both Jaggaer Supplier Management and Workday Finance

• Evaluate supplier profiles against defined criteria to identify candidates suitable for the new virtual card payment program

• Confirm and document virtual card eligibility status for each reviewed supplier

• Maintain a clear audit log/tracker of changes made, suppliers reviewed, and open items requiring follow-up

• Communicate findings and status updates to the Accounts Payable/Procurement team on a regular cadence (e.g., weekly)

• Escalate any unusual account changes, potential fraud indicators, or supplier disputes to the appropriate manager

 

Qualifications

• Prior experience in accounts payable, procurement, vendor management, or a related administrative/finance function

• Comfort reviewing contract documents and reconciling contract terms against system data (no legal background required, but attention to detail with contract language is important)

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets/spreadsheets

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., filtering, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and/or Google Sheets

• Experience with Jaggaer Supplier Management and/or Workday Finance strongly preferred; experience with other ERP or supplier management systems also considered

• Familiarity with virtual card/commercial card payment programs a plus, but not required

• Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial data

• Strong written communication skills for documenting findings and liaising with stakeholders

• Comfortable initiating outreach to external suppliers (via phone or email) to request corrected information professionally and follow up until resolved

job.title: Email Marketing Specialist
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our global media and entertainment client. This role will support the day-to-day production and execution of high-volume email campaigns, including newsletters, promotional communications, advertising initiatives, holiday campaigns, and international campaigns. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of experience in email marketing or digital campaign production, with strong attention to detail, hands-on experience formatting emails, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Email Marketing Specialist
Compensation: $30-35/hr
Type: 4 Month Contract with ability to extend or Convert
Location: Washington, DC area
 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, format, and deploy mobile-optimized email campaigns, newsletters, promotional communications, and automated email sequences.
  • Manage approximately 10 campaigns at various stages of development while supporting a high-volume team producing approximately 70 campaigns and projects per month.
  • Edit email content, images, banners, metadata, and minor HTML to ensure campaigns meet established quality and formatting standards.
  • Schedule email deployments and coordinate launch details across multiple stakeholders.
  • Insert and format promotional banners and supporting creative within email communications.
  • Conduct quality assurance testing to verify accurate content, links, tracking parameters, metadata, and rendering across desktop and mobile devices.
  • Develop and distribute campaign proofs for stakeholder review, feedback, and approval.
  • Execute A/B testing on subject lines, calls to action, send times, and other campaign elements.
  • Monitor campaign progress and communicate updates, risks, and required actions to project stakeholders.
  • Manage assignments, deadlines, approvals, and project status using Jira or similar project management tools.
  • Follow email marketing best practices, brand standards, privacy requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
  • Support occasional time-sensitive or breaking-news email deployments as needed.
Basic Qualifications:

  • 2–3 years of professional experience in email marketing, digital campaign production, marketing operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a large, high-volume corporate or media environment with tight deadlines.
  • Associate degree or equivalent professional experience required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Working knowledge of email marketing platforms and campaign management tools, such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with email formatting, minor HTML editing, and HTML coding concepts.
  • Familiarity with Photoshop or similar tools for editing and preparing digital assets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Jira or comparable project management software.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and work independently after training.
  • Ability to work onsite Monday through Thursday in the Washington, DC area and remotely on Fridays.
  • Flexibility to support occasional off-hours or time-sensitive campaign deployments.

job.title: Compliance and Operations Analyst
job.description:
Compliance and Operations Analyst
6+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
 
The Compliance and Operations Analyst supports the daily operation, security, and compliance of the organization's Transmission Management System (TMS) environment, ensuring adherence to applicable NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards and internal security protocols. This role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving NERC CIP policies, plans, procedures, and supporting documentation, as well as coordinating compliance activities across technical and business teams.

The analyst works closely with Operations, Security, Engineering, and Compliance stakeholders to identify risks, implement controls, and drive operational and process improvements that enhance system reliability, security, and regulatory compliance. The position plays a key role in facilitating change management activities by ensuring that operational changes are evaluated, implemented, and documented in a secure and compliant manner while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the TMS environment.

Responsibilities:
 
  • Support daily operational activities within the TMS environment.
  • Maintain and enhance NERC CIP compliance documentation, including policies, plans, procedures, and evidence repositories.
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable NERC CIP, regulatory, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Analyze operational and compliance processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, standardization, risk reduction, and regulatory readiness.
  • Partner with Operations, Cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to plan, review, and implement changes in a secure, reliable, and compliant manner.
  • Support vulnerability management, patch management, and baseline configuration monitoring activities.
  • Communicate effectively as a liaison between technical teams, program management, project sponsors, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure cybersecurity and compliance controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, including compliance evidence management and audit support activities.

Key Qualifications:
 
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting regulated operational technology (OT), transmission operations, cybersecurity, compliance, or related utility environments.
  • Knowledge of NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards and their application within electric utility environments.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and managing policies, plans, procedures, standards, and compliance documentation.
  • Understanding of Transmission Management Systems (TMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Operational Technology (OT), or other critical infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, including vulnerability management, patch management, access management, and configuration management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks, compliance gaps, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  • Experience coordinating activities across technical teams, compliance personnel, business stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused communications.
  • Knowledge of change management processes and the ability to support secure and compliant implementation of operational changes.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and recordkeeping.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating within cross-functional teams.

Measurements:
  • Maintains a high level of client satisfaction and builds positive effective relationships with clients and related stakeholders
  • Effective actions taken to minimize risk across Oncor
  • A track record of collaborative participation in the management of Oncor’s technology platforms
  • Compliance with applicable NERC CIP, FAA, FCC, etc. regulations
  • Effective documentation and communication of project milestones, risks, issues, deliverables, escalations, etc.

job.description:
RN needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s food manufacturing client located in Hanover, PA. This primary care clinic provides pediatric, woman, and adult care. Seeking and RN with experience in phlebotomy and EPIC as well as a willingness to support administration.
 
Schedule: Monday 7a-1p, Tuesday 11a-7p, Thursday 11a-4p, Friday 8a-3p
Duration: 5 months with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $38-50/HR depending experience
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Uses nursing skills to evaluate patient care needs, prioritize treatment, and maintain patient flow.
  • Conducts a nursing assessment by taking a patient history and physical assessment and by obtaining vital signs and other medical tests. Provides treatment within scope of practice as defined by state law.
  • Collaborates with Physician or other Licensed Independent Practitioner to arrange for further medical treatment, when needed.

  • Maintains a clean and safe environment. Follows infection control procedures.
  • Maintains patient privacy and confidential patient information.
  • Participates in follow up phone calls and follow up patient visits.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • RN License to practice in PA

  • Epic and front desk experience is preferred

job.title: Android Team Lead, Dallas, TX
job.description:
Lead Android Developer (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose)
Direct Hire
Richardson, TX (ONSITE)
 
Position Summary
We’re seeking a Lead Android Developer to design, build, and lead delivery of commercial-grade Android applications for a consumer banking environment. This role blends hands-on mobile engineering (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) with Agile team leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and strong influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders. You’ll help shape mobile architecture, champion quality and UX best practices, and drive reliable releases through modern CI/CD.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design and development of production Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
  • Own and evolve the mobile architecture (patterns, modularization, maintainability, performance, security, and test strategy).
  • Partner with product, design, QA, and backend teams to deliver high-quality features for consumer banking, including account management and customer onboarding.
  • Drive Agile execution: facilitate team rituals, refine stories, mentor engineers, and remove delivery blockers.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and appropriate third-party libraries, ensuring reliability, scalability, and secure data handling.
  • Champion mobile UI/UX principles and accessibility best practices to create intuitive, engaging customer experiences.
  • Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines for mobile builds, testing, and deployment; ensure consistent release quality.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, translating technical tradeoffs into business impact and influencing decisions.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 10–12+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial-grade software systems.
  • 4+ years leading Agile teams (formal or informal leadership: tech lead, lead engineer, team lead).
  • Expert-level experience building production Android apps with:
    • Kotlin
    • Jetpack Compose
  • Experience in consumer banking, specifically account management and onboarding.
  • Strong experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices (responsiveness, accessibility, consistency, usability).

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting product and manufacturing quality through inspection and testing strategies, defect analysis, statistical analysis, documentation control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Development, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to ensure products and processes meet company, customer, and industry quality standards. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify quality issues, develop effective solutions, and drive improvements in a regulated environment.

Industry: Medical Device 
Location: Redondo Beach, CA
Compensation: $48.00–$50.00/hour
Type: Temp-to-Hire

Job Functions
  • Review and thoroughly understand product functional and design specifications.
  • Develop and implement methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Design or specify inspection and testing mechanisms and equipment.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance testing to ensure products meet established requirements.
  • Perform statistical analysis to evaluate products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct defect analysis utilizing statistical quality and process analytical methods.
  • Prepare and maintain Quality reports and support documentation control systems.
  • Review returned materials and verify customer complaints, developing action plans to address identified discrepancies.
  • Communicate with customers regarding Quality issues and resolutions as required.
  • Partner with operators and technicians to identify and resolve day-to-day Quality Assurance issues.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects while working within design specifications and budget requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of evolving Quality Assurance codes, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Document test cases and interpret technical and business objectives.
  • Work closely with Development and Product teams to support Quality initiatives.
  • Identify software bugs and support appropriate testing and resolution activities.
  • Recommend changes and improvements to enhance overall product quality.
  • Ensure products comply with company and applicable industry Quality standards.
  • Develop and implement systems that promote conformity and accuracy throughout the production process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions for identified Quality and product issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; Master's degree in Engineering preferred.
  • Professional certifications or 10+ years of equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Previous experience working in a Quality Assurance environment required.
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable EU standards.
  • MDR experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance and testing tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and scripting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office and technical equipment.
  • Ability to work within manufacturing, Quality, and product development environments as required.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, test results, and Quality records for extended periods.

job.title: Research Scientist, Automation/Biochemistry
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term opportunity for a Scientist within Automation/Biochemistry for a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 


Key Responsibilities:
Laboratory Automation:
  • Develop and test protocols on complex, integrated laboratory automation systems
  • Problem solve and implement custom solutions for scientists using automation work cells
  • Implementation of liquid handling methods across a variety of available equipment
  • Work with scientists to set up interfaces between databases and laboratory instrumentation
  • Troubleshoot and aid with error handling and maintenance of automation systems
  • Regularly provide and update technical documentation
  • Provide user support and training
Database and inventory management
  • Work with internal automation, digital, and computational teams to implement data management and visualization best practices.                                
  • Statistical interpretation and data correlation (PCA, tSNE, or similar)
  • Data analysis for a myriad of biochemical data including protein-protein interactions (ELISA, SPR, BLI…), protein quality (SEC, DSF, DSC…), biochemical (SEC, protein thermal shift…) and biophysical (SPR, BLI…)      
  • Demonstrate technical proficiency with the ability to problem solve in a broad array of experimental protocols.
Project Contribution
  • Present concise scientific presentations in line with project objectives
  • Support and in some cases lead internal site-specific projects.
  • Assist with and/or prepare publications, proposals, reports, patents, and grant applications.
  • Critically evaluate relevant literature to provide experimental and strategic input to senior team members as needed.
  • Actively take part in the training of technical staff
GRP and HSE
  • Comply with the company safety policies and HSE to minimize risk to self, others and the environment, consistent with HSE policies, community and industry standards.
  • Identify and help to improve best practices in HSE operations.
  • Ensure documentation of laboratory experiments are entered in ELSE in a timely manner: analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data.
  • Participate in generating/reviewing SOPs and other required documents.
  • Remain compliant with applicable trainings.
Qualifications & Skills:
Ph.D. in data science, computer science, or related field with 0-2 years of experience, or Masters’ degree and 5 years’ experience. Knowledge and hands-on experience with Hamilton Venus, Cellario (or other integration scheduling software), GeneData Biologics, Benchling, and/or Python and basic computer programming.
Strong interpersonal, communication, collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving skills are required.
Understanding of laboratory practices and biochemical/scientific terminology are required.

  • $18/hr. max hourly rate

Occupational Health Registered Nurse (RN) needed for a part-time, 24 hours per week, temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-established client located in Cedar Rapids, IA.
---> Job is anticipating to transition to full-time Monday-Friday around September 2026 with opportunity for temp-to-hire!


This clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees onsite. Duties will consist of first-aid, basic walk-in care (minor acute care like colds, rashes, pink eye, etc.), assisting with surveillance exams, responding to medical emergencies, and a lot of computer work.

--> SHIFTS: anticipating to be 3 days a week between Monday and Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm and if chosen for the long-term opening, hours will transition to full-time Monday-Friday, 7:30am to 4:00pm.

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of Iowa

job.title: Research Associate II – Drug Discovery
job.description:
Research Associate II – Drug Discovery

Seattle, WA | Onsite | Direct Hire
Anticipated Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000

Yoh is proactively building a talent pipeline for an anticipated Research Associate II – Drug Discovery opportunity with a biotechnology company in Seattle, WA.

We are seeking a hands-on bench scientist with particularly strong RT-qPCR and mammalian cell culture experience who enjoys assay development, troubleshooting, and supporting early-stage drug discovery research.

This individual will work closely with scientists across biology, proteomics, automation, and computational disciplines to execute molecular and cell-based experiments, evaluate compound activity, validate screening hits, and optimize assays supporting drug discovery programs.

What You’ll Do
  • Perform mammalian cell culture, including maintenance and experimental manipulation of cancer cell lines.
  • Execute RT-qPCR and multiplex RT-qPCR assays to evaluate gene expression and compound activity.
  • Design, evaluate, and optimize primers, probes, and oligonucleotides.
  • Conduct cell-based assays, including viability, proliferation, apoptosis, reporter, and compound-response assays.
  • Perform compound-treatment, dose-response, and follow-up validation experiments.
  • Support validation and characterization of hits identified through screening campaigns.
  • Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and scale molecular and cell-based biological assays.
  • Analyze experimental results and communicate findings to cross-functional scientific teams.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory documentation, protocols, and experimental records.
  • Collaborate with scientists across biology, proteomics, automation, and computational/data-science functions.

What We’re Looking For
  • Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, cell biology, cancer biology, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Approximately 3+ years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience; candidates with a master’s degree and relevant practical laboratory experience may also be considered.
  • Strong hands-on RT-qPCR experience.
  • Strong hands-on mammalian cell-culture experience.
  • Experience designing, selecting, or optimizing primers, probes, or oligonucleotides.
  • Experience developing, optimizing, or troubleshooting biological assays.
  • Ability to independently organize, execute, document, and analyze multiple experiments.
  • Strong scientific communication and laboratory documentation skills.

Preferred Experience
  • Biotechnology or pharmaceutical drug-discovery experience.
  • Experience working with cancer cell lines.
  • Compound screening or hit-validation experience.
  • Multiplex RT-qPCR.
  • CRISPR, RNAi, transfection, or related gene-perturbation techniques.
  • Gene-regulation or transcription-factor biology.
  • Medium- or high-throughput screening.
  • Laboratory automation.
  • GraphPad Prism or similar scientific-analysis software.

Ideal Candidate
The strongest candidate will be a hands-on Research Associate who has personally performed RT-qPCR and mammalian cell culture at the bench and can speak in detail about assay optimization, troubleshooting, experimental design, and data interpretation.

This opportunity is especially well suited for a scientist who enjoys solving experimental problems, working across multiple biological techniques, and contributing directly to fast-moving drug-discovery programs.

Position Details
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Location: Seattle, WA
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Anticipated Base Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000 annually

This is an anticipated upcoming hiring need. Yoh is proactively identifying qualified candidates in advance of the client’s hiring timeline.

job.title: Sr. Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Sr. Engineer - Process Development
Primary Duties: The Sr. Engineer reports to Principal Engineer and is an integral part of mRNA Drug Substance Process Development team. This position offers opportunities to focus on mRNA drug substance process development, manufacturing, regulatory and analytical support, validation, and data review for drug substances and drug products. The Engineer is responsible for leading and assisting the development and execution of scalable and robust processes for drug substance. This position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for process knowledge transfer for drug substance to support current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) manufacturing.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
40%
    • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues, and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality
    • Scale-up:
      • Lead/Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
40%
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Lead implementation of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
10%
    • Lead project activities for the design of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
    • Document Generation
      • Author and review MBRs
      • Author and review SOPs
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Manufacturing Analytical
5%
    • Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assuance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
    • Work with internal and external manufacturing on harmonization of electronic batch records.
    • Work with Digital team withing PD and CMC on the implementation of eBRs and data capture strategy.
    • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale.
    • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
    • Review and follow QA procedures.
5%
    • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements
    • Technical reports (2.5%)
      • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
    • Presentations (2.5%)
    • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.

Education and Experience Requirements:
    • 6+ (Masters) or 8+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required.
    • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
    • Demonstrated experience in process development, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals is required.
    • Experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, MSAT, and/or Process Development (PD) is required (4+ years).
    • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred. 
    • Experience implementing and maintaining electronic batch records (eBRs) is required (1+ years).  Experience using Tempo Apprentice strongly preferred.

job.title: QA Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a QA Specialist,  for our diagnostics customer in North County San Diego.  The QA Specialist will be ensuring effective management of documentation, training, and quality system processes in compliance with FDA quality system regulations and applicable ISO standards

Pay Rate - $35-$43/hr
Schedule - 8am - 4:30pm 
Location - Carlsbad
Duration - contract-to-hire

Responsibilities:
  • Under the direction of the Senior Quality Systems Manager, this position is responsible for maintaining Document Control and Training Management Systems in compliance with internal procedures and applicable global regulations. 
  • Ensure products or services meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Review, approve, and release batch records in accordance with approved procedures and documented acceptance criteria within defined timelines.
  • Generate certificates of compliance, information sheets, manufacturing declarations and USDSA APHIS documentation for outgoing shipments.
  • Perform verification and effectiveness checks for CAPAs, deviations, and nonconformance reports, including documentation of objective evidence to support effectiveness and formal closure.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of cGMP and GDP by independently scheduling and conducting monthly laboratory walk-throughs and annual internal audits based on an approved audit schedule, with documented action reports and follow-up tracking.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify documented root causes using appropriate analytical methods and support corrective and preventive actions.
  • Complete customer and vendor quality questionnaires.
  • Support Management Review meetings by preparing and presenting quality metrics, trends, and performance data to support management review inputs and documented outputs.
  • Maintain and manage Quality Management System (QMS) subsystems in accordance with regulatory and standard requirements, including: CAPAs, NCRs, Customer Complaints, Doc Control, Equipment and Facilities support, and Supplier qualification and management. 
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline or Associate’s degree in a scientific discipline with relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of QA work experience.
  • Quality Assurance experience in a cGMP and/or manufacturing environment
  • Working knowledge of FDA QMSR, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 14971
  • Experience with GDP
