job.title: Core/Senior Network Engineer - Wayne PA - RTH
job.description:
This is a Right to Hire role working onside in Wayne PA

Core/Senior Network Engineer
Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Network Engineer to join our infrastructure team and support a large enterprise office environment. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting network technologies across a multi-vendor ecosystem while driving network automation initiatives and supporting broader cybersecurity efforts.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in enterprise networking, strong automation capabilities, and a collaborative mindset. In addition to maintaining a reliable and secure network infrastructure, this individual will work closely with desktop support, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure exceptional technology services for a large user population.
This position requires an onsite presence four days per week and involves direct support of office-based technology operations.
Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, support, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across a multi-vendor environment.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routing and switching technologies.
  • Support a diverse technology stack including solutions from HPE, Aruba, Cisco, Palo Alto, Zscaler, and other industry-leading vendors.
  • Manage and support firewalls, secure web gateways, proxy services, and network security technologies.
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python, Ansible, and related automation frameworks.
  • Automate network provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and operational workflows.
  • Support enterprise wireless and Wi-Fi infrastructure, including deployment, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Troubleshoot complex network performance, connectivity, and security issues.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams on infrastructure hardening, security initiatives, and network-related projects.
  • Collaborate with desktop support and workplace technology teams to resolve end-user technology issues and improve service delivery.
  • Evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and related technologies, to enhance operational efficiency and automation.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects involving networking, security, cloud connectivity, and office technology modernization.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
Qualifications
Required Experience
  • 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols and architectures.
  • Experience supporting enterprise firewall and network security technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Experience working within multi-vendor networking environments.
  • Strong understanding of wireless and Wi-Fi technologies.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and connectivity issues.
  • Experience supporting corporate office environments and end-user technology services.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience with HPE, Aruba, Cisco, Palo Alto, and/or Zscaler technologies.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise office environments.
  • Exposure to cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure architectures.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted operational tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.
  • Experience participating in cybersecurity and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Keys to the Position
  1. Core/Senior-level enterprise networking expertise with strong routing, switching, and network operations experience.
  2. Network automation experience using Python, Ansible, or similar automation technologies.
  3. Multi-vendor network environment experience (Cisco, HPE, Aruba, Palo Alto, Zscaler, etc.).
  4. Hands-on support mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve real-time networking issues.
  5. Strong wireless/Wi-Fi expertise within enterprise environments.
  6. Network security knowledge, including firewalls, web proxies, and secure access technologies.
  7. Collaborative approach and willingness to support desktop, infrastructure, and security teams as needed.
  8. Interest in emerging technologies and AI tools that can improve operational efficiency and automation.
  9. Comfort working onsite four days per week and supporting a large office environment.
  10. Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Why This Role Stands Out
This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting a modern enterprise networking environment while driving automation, improving security posture, and influencing the adoption of emerging technologies. The position offers broad exposure across networking, cybersecurity, workplace technology, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

job.title: Sr. Research Associate- ESI Flow Cytometry
job.description:
Research Associate - ESI Flow Cytometry
Primary Duties: The Yoh resource is expected to apply expertise across several practical skills including flow cytometry and cell sorting in support of the Client’s Vaccines R&D Global Immunology function. The role is a lab-based research scientist who will be participating in various teams to support preclinical and early clinical evaluation of vaccine candidates against various respiratory viruses. Knowledge of immunoassay instruments, including flow cytometer analyzers, high-speed sorter, centrifuges, multi-mode plate readers and plate washers will be required. Individual will be performing laboratory work including flow cytometry and immunoassays, recording data in specified formats and/or recording detailed day-to-day work in electronic laboratory notebook. Responsibilities will include reagent preparation, lab housekeeping and flow cytometry analyzers and cell sorters maintenance. Applicant must be capable of working both independently and as part of a structured team.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support experimental assay design, optimization, and execute multi-parameter flow cytometry panels (beyond 20 colors) for comprehensive T cell and B cell subset identification
  • Execute multi-cytokine  Intracellular Cytokine Staining (ICS) assays (IFN-?, TNF-?, IL-2, IL-4, IL-17, etc.) following antigen-specific stimulationOperate and maintain flow cytometers (conventional and spectral platforms) with adherence to quality control protocols
  • Execute high-speed, high-purity cell sorting using Sony or similar instrumentation for isolation of antigen-specific T cell and B cell populations or other cell subsets of interest.
  • Optimize sort gates and collection strategies to maximize cell recovery and purity
  • Troubleshoot sort performance issues including clogging, deflection plate alignment, and collection efficiency
  • Analyze flow cytometry data using industry-standard software (OMIQ)
  • Apply appropriate gating strategies following established SOPs and scientific best practices
  • Analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data in electronic laboratory notebook.
  • Conduct experiments and prepare powerpoint slides for internal presentations as required.
  • Write standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documents for methods, instruments, or work processes as required.
  • Collaborate as needed with internal partners in other functional areas, external vendors, and external scientific partners.
  • Comply with the company safety policies and minimize risk to self, others, and the environment, consistent with the community and industry standards.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • BS with 4+ years or MS with 2+ years relevant experience. Degree should be in Immunology, Biotechnology, Virology, Biochemistry or related field.
  • Hands-on expertise with multi-parameter flow cytometry (minimum 10-color panels) and/or cell sorting .
  • Demonstrated experience with intracellular cytokine staining in preclinical and/ or human PBMC samples and/or ability to execute sterile sorts, optimize sort gates, and troubleshoot sorter performance.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
  • Proficiency in flow cytometry data analysis software (OMIQ preferred)
  • Working knowledge with Good Research Practice (GRP).
  • Ability to expresses one’s self clearly and concisely within team.
  • Good time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work in agile team environment.
  • Attention to details.
  • Data review
  • Training
  • Scheduling
  • GDP
  • GRP, compliance requirements for clinical trial samples.


Estimated Min Rate: $28.00
Estimated Max Rate: $40.00

job.title: Senior Change Management Resource - Remote - Financial Services
job.description:
Job Summary:
The Change resource is responsible for working as part of the Change Team to implement and manage change activities (including Training) within the project to ensure successful business adoption of new technologies and operating model.
This role involves working closely with stakeholders and Change team members to assess change impacts, execute change management interventions, and support employees through communication, training, and engagement activities. Key Responsibilities:
  • Support the assessment of change impact on business processes, systems, and employees.
  • Collaborate with project managers and other stakeholders to ensure change initiatives are effectively integrated.
  • Work with communications team in designing and delivering communication plans to keep all stakeholders informed and engaged throughout the change process.
  • Develop training programs and materials to support adoption of new processes, tools, or systems.
  • Identify and manage resistance to change, providing coaching and support to affected individuals and teams.
  • Monitor and report on change progress, adoption rates, and effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Facilitate workshops, focus groups, and feedback sessions to gather input and address concerns.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and standards related to change management.
  • Continuously help to improve change management methodologies and tools based on lessons learned and best practices.
  Experience:
  • Proven experience (typically 7+ years) in change management or organizational development roles.
  • Change Management certification (e.g., Prosci, ACMP) is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of change management principles, methodologies, and tools.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience in financial services desirable
  • Knowledge of Agile and Lean methodologies.
  • Excellent Microsoft office suite expertise – Powerpoint and excel

job.title: Camera Image Quality, Driver Development, and Characterization Engineer
job.description:
Camera Image Quality, Driver Development, and Characterization Engineer
We are seeking an engineer to support camera image quality (IQ) evaluation, driver development, and characterization for advanced vehicle camera systems. This role will execute laboratory and real-world testing, develop test methodologies, analyze data, and communicate findings to camera engineering stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines camera and optical testing experience with Python-based automation and embedded C/C++ development.

Scope:
• Execute camera image quality, characterization, and performance testing in laboratory and real-world environments.
• Develop, maintain, and operate camera IQ test benches, measurement systems, and supporting equipment.
• Create and improve test software for automated data acquisition, analysis, and visualization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods and communicate results, trends, and recommendations.
• Write technical reports documenting characterization results, issues, and recommended actions.
• Develop new test setups and methodologies to expand camera validation capabilities.
• Design, implement, and maintain C/C++ device drivers for automotive CMOS image sensors and video-capture hardware.
• Develop and optimize drivers for multi-gigabit automotive SerDes links, including GMSL2/GMSL3.
• Implement and debug communications across MIPI CSI-2, I2C, Automotive Ethernet, and related interfaces.
• Support camera module bring-up using bench setups, frame grabbers, and diagnostic tools.
• Develop bus-transaction logging utilities, Built-In Self-Test (BIST) routines, and fault-recovery mechanisms.
• Support development practices aligned with automotive functional-safety requirements, including ISO 26262.

Required:
• 2+ years of embedded software development experience using modern C++ and C in Linux or RTOS environments.
• Hands-on experience developing low-level device drivers for image sensors, video-capture hardware, or high-speed peripherals.
• Experience with camera image quality, image sensors, electronics, or imaging systems.
• Experience creating, maintaining, and operating sensitive laboratory measurement setups.
• Proficiency with Python or similar tools for test automation, data acquisition, and analysis.
• Knowledge of CMOS image sensor architecture, basic analog circuits, electronics, and camera system design.
• Experience with imaging lab equipment such as light sources, lux meters, test charts, lenses, optical filters, and opto-mechanical components.
• Understanding of statistical analysis, including variation, uncertainty, and measures of central tendency.
• Strong problem-solving, technical documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
• Ability to work independently with limited supervision while maintaining a clean and professional lab environment.

Pluses:
• Direct experience with automotive multi-gigabit SerDes architectures, including GMSL2 or GMSL3.
• Experience with Automotive Ethernet, including 100BASE-T1 or 1000BASE-T1.
• Experience with high-throughput network-streaming pipelines.
• Experience developing BIST, diagnostics, logging, or fault-recovery systems.
• Experience applying ISO 26262 or other automotive functional-safety standards.
• Experience with Excel, COM-capable programming environments, or statistical software.
 

Estimated Min Rate: $50.00
Estimated Max Rate: $80.00/hr +. Depends on work experience.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $23.00 to $25.00/Hr.

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.

Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.description:
Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
We are seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to support materials intake, document printing, filing, and delivery activities. This role will organize incoming vehicle compliance materials, maintain accurate records, prepare documents for distribution, and coordinate deliveries to Waymo depots and offices, FedEx, and other locations as needed.
 
Scope:
• Receive, inspect, and organize incoming materials and documentation.
• Print, prepare, label, and file documents according to established procedures.
• Maintain accurate physical and digital filing systems.
• Track materials, documents, shipments, and delivery status.
• Update electronic trackers and share communications to reflect the latest materials status.
• Prepare packages and materials for depot delivery, including locations such as Waymo's depots.
• Coordinate FedEx shipments and other deliveries as required.
• Deliver or distribute materials to depots and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized work area and ensure materials are stored appropriately.
• Identify missing, damaged, or incorrect materials and escalate issues.
• Support general administrative and materials coordination tasks.
 
Required:
• Experience with materials intake, document control, filing, shipping, or logistics support.
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to accurately print, label, sort, and maintain records.
• Familiarity with FedEx or similar shipping platforms.
• Ability to follow procedures and manage multiple requests.
• Basic computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, printing, and document management.
• Reliable transportation or ability to support local deliveries, if required.
 
Pluses:
• Experience supporting depot, warehouse, laboratory, or operations environments.
• Familiarity with inventory or document-tracking systems.

job.title: Trading & Onboarding Consultant
job.description:
Trading & Onboarding Consultant
Fort Mill, SC; Tempe, AZ; San Diego, CA (Hybrid)
6+ month contract
 
Job Overview:
The role will assist with advisor onboarding, platform training, conversion-data review, inbound support, post-conversion issue resolution, and updates to advisor guides and training materials. Successful candidates will be comfortable learning detailed trading workflows, communicating with financial professionals, researching issues, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provide support related to model management, model assignments, restrictions, equivalents, portfolio rebalancing, and block trading workflows.
  • Assist with platform training through webinars, demonstrations, office hours, scheduled appointments, and inbound calls.
  • Help users understand documented differences between systems and workflows.
  • Review available conversion information to identify missing models, assignments, restrictions, equivalents, or other setup issues.
  • Research and document advisor, account, model, and system-related questions.
  • Escalate complex discrepancies or potentially broader conversion issues to the appropriate business or technology partner.
  • Help update job aids, FAQs, training materials, and guides explaining key differences between workflows.
  • Track advisor questions, issue ownership, status, and follow-up through resolution.
  • Support system testing, defect tracking, and post-conversion stabilization activities.
  • Maintain working knowledge of investment products, trading systems, model-based practices, and rebalancing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with Trading, Technology, Product, Operations, Training, and conversion partners.
  • Support additional trading and operational priorities as conversion demand changes.
  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
 
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of financial services or trading operations
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-service, support, operations, or call-center environment Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to explain technical or operational information clearly
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through
  • Ability to research information across multiple systems or data sources
  • Ability to learn new platforms and workflows quickly
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with limited direction
  • Sound judgment when identifying and escalating issues
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • Advisor service and relationship support
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Clear communication
  • Process discipline and follow-through
  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn
  • Issue ownership and escalation
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • FINRA Series 7 strongly preferred
  • Financial-services, trading, or investment-operations experience
  • Knowledge of mutual funds, equities, ETFs, or options
  • Experience with model-based portfolio management or rebalancing
  • Experience supporting models, restrictions, equivalents, or trading instructions
  • Experience providing advisor or client support by phone
  • Experience supporting onboarding, training, conversions, acquisitions, or technology implementations
  • Experience with data review, reconciliation, QA/UAT testing, or issue tracking
  • Experience with ClientWorks Rebalancer, Advisor360, BETA, Model Hub, or similar trading and portfolio-management platforms

job.title: IT Writer & Communications Specialist
job.description:
IT WRITER & COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST - ONSITE IN BOSTON 

- 3 month temp position (potential to extend)
- onsite in Boston 
- $50/hr on W2 

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!!

Job Summary
Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking a dynamic IT Writer and Communications Specialist to drive Northeastern's digital transformation forward. In this pivotal role, you'll be the strategic communications leader who transforms complex technology changes into compelling narratives that inspire and empower our university community. You'll craft communication strategies that don't just inform—they guide, educate, and motivate thousands of faculty, staff, and students through major system implementations and process innovations, both big and small.

As our communications bridge between technical teams and end users, you'll translate intricate technical concepts into powerful, accessible messaging that resonates across diverse audiences. You'll collaborate at the highest levels with IT project teams, university leadership, and key business stakeholders to anticipate challenges, shape perceptions, and orchestrate communication campaigns that ensure successful technology adoption and organizational change.

Key Responsibilities Change Communication and Stakeholder Engagement (40%)

  • Develop comprehensive communication plans for IT projects that guide stakeholders through system changes, process updates, and technology implementations
  • Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, leadership, and business stakeholders to understand project impacts on different user groups
  • Create targeted messaging that explains "what's changing," "why it's changing," "how it affects you," and "what you need to do" for various stakeholder segments
  • Design and execute multi-channel communication campaigns to support organizational change initiatives
Content Development and Technical Translation (35%)

  • Write and edit compelling, accessible content for web, email, digital signage, print, user interfaces, and other communication channels
  • Translate technical concepts, system requirements, and process changes into language appropriate for diverse audiences (faculty, staff, students, administrators)
  • Develop training materials, quick reference guides, FAQs, and other resources that help users adapt to new systems and processes
  • Create informational and educational content that drives user engagement and adoption of new technologies
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Project Support (20%)

  • Partner with IT project teams to understand technical requirements, timelines, and user impacts throughout project lifecycles
  • Participate in project planning meetings to provide communications expertise and identify potential user concerns early
  • Collaborate with training teams, help desk staff, and other support functions to ensure consistent messaging across all user touchpoints
  • Work with campus-wide partners to coordinate communications and minimize change fatigue
Strategic Communication and Continuous Improvement (5%)

  • Contribute to overall IT communications strategy and help identify opportunities to improve change communication processes
  • Monitor communication effectiveness through user feedback, adoption metrics, and other data sources
  • Stay current on change management best practices and emerging communication technologies
  • Counsel leadership on communication strategies for complex or sensitive technology changes
Required Qualifications
  • Substantial experience in marketing, communications, or related field, preferably in higher education, technology, or organizational change environments
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to adapt messaging for different audiences
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to quickly understand complex systems, processes, and technical concepts
  • Project collaboration experience with demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including technical staff, project managers, and various stakeholders
  • Change communication experience or strong interest in helping organizations and individuals navigate transitions
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills including collaborative features in Word, SharePoint, Excel, Teams, and Outlook
  • Self-directed work style with strong project management abilities and attention to detail
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, changing environments with shifting priorities
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ITIL processes, change management frameworks, or IT service management
  • Proficiency with content management systems (WordPress, Contentful, or similar) and email marketing platforms
  • Familiarity with user experience (UX) principles and user-centered design thinking
  • Experience creating multimedia content (graphics, video, interactive materials)
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
  • Data analysis skills for measuring communication effectiveness and user engagement
  • Experience in complex organizational environments or higher education settings
AI and Technology Fluency
  • Curiosity and openness to exploring AI-powered tools for content creation, editing, optimization, and distribution
  • Interest in leveraging technology to enhance communication processes and user experiences
  • Willingness to experiment with emerging communication technologies and platforms
  • Understanding that AI literacy is increasingly important in modern communications roles
Personal Qualities
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with ability to anticipate user concerns and communication challenges
  • Empathetic approach to understanding how change impacts different user groups
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence without direct authority
  • Resilience and flexibility when projects shift or timelines change
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development
  • Customer service orientation with focus on user success
Working Environment This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office to facilitate collaboration with project teams, stakeholders, and IT colleagues. On-campus presence is essential for building relationships, understanding user needs firsthand, and contributing to our collaborative culture

job.description:
VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

job.title: Sr. Program Manager II
job.description:
This position is W2 only. No C-C Accepted

Job Title: Senior Program Manager
3 days onsite - Charlotte North Carolina 6-12 months contract to hire


Job Description
The Senior Program Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing multiple projects aligned to a shared business objective. This role provides leadership across project teams, manages dependencies and risks, oversees budgets and resources, coordinates testing efforts, and ensures stakeholders and leadership have timely visibility into program status.

Program and Project Management
Direct and manage multiple project efforts from initiation through completion.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
Identify and resolve project issues, risks, conflicts, and resource constraints.
Proactively manage changes in project scope and develop appropriate mitigation and contingency plans.
Coordinate activities across business, technology, and project teams to ensure alignment with program objectives.
Track project budgets, resource allocations, and expenditures to support accurate forecasting and reporting.

Communication and Stakeholder Management
Establish the frequency, format, and content of project and program status reporting.
Communicate project expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and deliverables clearly to team members and stakeholders.
Analyze project results, identify problem areas, and drive resolution with appropriate teams.
Facilitate communication across business and technology stakeholders to maintain alignment and accountability.

Documentation and Planning
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, communications, status reports, proposals, budgets, estimates, and supporting documentation.
Document project dependencies, milestones, risks, issues, decisions, and action items.
Ensure project documentation remains accurate and current throughout the project lifecycle.

Management Reporting
Prepare and deliver timely program and project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.
Provide appropriate escalation of risks, issues, delays, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
Ensure decision-makers have accurate, relevant, and up-to-date information regarding project progress, financials, risks, and overall program health.

User Acceptance Testing Coordination
Coordinate and oversee User Acceptance Testing activities across business areas supporting technology projects within the program.
Ensure testing responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, issues, and completion status are clearly communicated and tracked.
Partner with business and technology teams to support issue resolution and successful completion of testing prior to implementation.

job.title: Project Engineer (Data Center Systems)
job.description:
Project Engineer (Data Center Systems) 
 
This role will support a technical program owner while partnering closely with technical leads responsible for facility developments within large?scale data centers. This role is centered on data center infrastructure: racks, cooling systems, mechanical/electrical interfaces, containment solutions, structural framing, and spatial systems integration that enable high?density compute deployments. Day?to?day, this person will participate in highly technical engineering discussions regarding evolving hardware requirements, fan coil units, cooling strategies, and holistic power, mechanical, and structural integration. They will interpret these multidisciplinary requirements and translate them into clear engineering bulletins, design documents, and decision logs.
The Project Engineer will perform or review CAD/BIM modeling (Revit, SolidWorks, and other BIM tools) to evaluate overall building systems integration. They will run and support large cross?functional meetings (often with 50+ participants) across internal teams and vendors, ensuring alignment and driving clarity across multiple concurrent workstreams. This role requires strong engineering intuition across multiple building disciplines, the ability to follow complex technical conversations without being spoon?fed, and the autonomy to drive forward ambiguous, rapidly evolving engineering requirements specific to data center infrastructure.

Must Haves:
  • 5–7 years of experience as a Project Engineer supporting data centers
  • Background in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering
  • Experience with CAD/BIM modeling tools (Revit, SolidWorks, BIM, or similar)
  • Experience supporting engineering work related to racks, cooling systems, fan coil units, or mechanical interfaces
  • Ability to follow highly technical discussions across structural, mechanical, electrical, and architectural domains
  • Experience running or supporting large cross?functional meetings
  • Strong technical writing skills for engineering bulletins, design decisions, and documentation updates
  • Ability to work with high autonomy, ask the right questions, and execute without step?by?step direction

Nice to Haves:
  • Server hall experience (rack integration, chip deployments, cooling evolution)
  • Experience at a hyperscale data center operator
  • Experience with fan coil units or cooling systems that evolve with chip/rack requirements
  • Exposure to design verification testing (DVT)
  • Familiarity with power architecture
  • Experience supporting teams deploying TPUs, GPUs, or other high?density chips

job.title: Principal ASIC Design Engineer
job.description:
Principal ASIC Design Engineer RTL / Microarchitecture / High-Performance Networking Overview Seeking a Principal ASIC Design Engineer to own front-end design for complex, high-performance silicon used in advanced networking and AI infrastructure. This role will work closely with architecture, verification, emulation, DFT, and physical design teams to translate product requirements into robust microarchitecture and production-ready RTL.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep RTL design experience, multiple successful tapeouts, and a strong understanding of performance, power, area, timing, and design quality.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define microarchitecture and implement synthesizable RTL for complex ASIC blocks and subsystems.
  • Develop high-quality SystemVerilog designs optimized for performance, power, area, and timing.
  • Partner with Design Verification and Emulation teams on test strategy, debug, coverage closure, and design intent.
  • Work with Physical Design and DFT teams on synthesis, timing closure, area optimization, clocking, and test logic integration.
  • Review design reports, identify architectural or RTL bottlenecks, and drive fixes through tapeout and silicon bring-up.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of ASIC or SoC logic design experience with strong hands-on RTL development.
  • Strong SystemVerilog experience and solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, CDC, synthesis, timing, and clocking.
  • Experience defining microarchitecture and developing complex ASIC blocks from specification through implementation.
  • Ability to debug cross-functional issues with Verification, Emulation, Physical Design, and DFT teams.
  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 12+ years of relevant experience with multiple successful ASIC tapeouts.
  • Experience with Lint, CDC, RDC, formal verification, synthesis, STA, and front-end design methodology.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, or similar languages.
  • Experience analyzing timing, power, and area reports and making RTL or architectural changes to improve PPA.
  • Exposure to silicon bring-up and post-silicon debug.
  • Experience with high-performance networking ASICs, Ethernet switch silicon, packet processing, low-latency datapaths, NoC, SerDes integration, or AI infrastructure silicon.
  • Background in switch ASICs, NICs, DPUs, network processors, or data center networking is a strong plus.

job.title: Electrical Systems Test Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Systems Test Engineer
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Systems Test Engineer to support the verification and validation (V&V) of electrical systems in autonomous vehicle platforms. This role will involve executing tests across multiple environments, developing test plans for high and low voltage components, and providing technical assistance to fellow engineers. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power electronics, electromechanical systems, and hands-on electrical lab work.

Scope:
• Support V&V activities for electrical systems in both new and existing autonomous vehicle platforms
• Execute test procedures in environments such as full vehicles, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) systems, and hardware test benches
• Collaborate with engineers to create new test plans for vehicle electrical systems, power generation modules, and low voltage batteries
• Provide technical guidance to test engineers and conductors during verification activities
• Contribute to test setup, troubleshooting, and debugging of electrical and electromechanical subsystems

Required:
• Proven experience testing power electronics and high/low voltage electrical systems
• Skilled in test planning and experimental design, with a focus on safety and repeatability
• Background in electromechanical systems that integrate hardware, electrical systems, communication protocols, and software
• Strong hands-on skills with wiring, soldering, and harness creation
• Proficient with electrical test tools including oscilloscopes, DMMs, power loads, programmable power supplies, etc.
• Experience using data acquisition tools such as Vector CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe, ETAS INCA, MDA, etc.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, which may include education in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace, or related fields

Pluses:
• Experience building and debugging electromechanical systems
• Strong understanding of low-level electronic components (e.g., transistors, relays, capacitors, diodes) and their role in PCB assemblies
• Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g., Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink)
• Experience working in environments with hardware/software integration challenges

job.title: Senior Refrigeration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineer for our Research and Development Client in Marietta, Ohio. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team!

Job Functions:
  • Design and develop cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Develop specifications for system-level, subsystem and component performance.
  • Execute test plans to validate the performance of newly developed refrigeration systems by utilizing design for reliability tools and performance sensitivity analysis.
  • Design refrigeration systems that meet customer requirements, time to market commitments and that are within the target cost of the projects.
  • Analyze the thermal behavior of the refrigeration system with thermo-physical tools for component selection and overall refrigeration system design.
  • Ensure refrigeration designs are Designed for Compliance to meet regulatory and certification requirements (e.g., UL, IEC, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star).
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs.
  •  Thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing
  •  Analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration system testing methods and equipment
#IND-SPG

job.title: Senior Quality Control Chemist Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Quality Control Technician for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Senior Quality Control Technician will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.
Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN
Compensation: $28/hr
Type:Direct Hire 

Job Functions·
· Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
· Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
· Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
· Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
· Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
· Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
· Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
· Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
· Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
· Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
· Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
· Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming.
· Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
· Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
· Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
· Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
· Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
· Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
· Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
· Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.

Education,
· Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
· 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
· Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
· Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
· Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
· Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
· Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
· Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
· Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

Preferred Qualifications·
·  Two-year technical degree.
· Training or certification related to ISO 13485 and FDA quality systems.
· Experience with sterilization, microbiology, and chemistry.
· Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practices.
· Strong manual dexterity.

Physical Job Requirements·
· Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or operate objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
· Frequently required to communicate verbally and hear.
· Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
· Specific vision requirements include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
· Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Junior Endpoint Engineer - Java Remediation & Patching
job.description:
Junior Endpoint Engineer – Java Remediation & Patching
Location: Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
4+ month contract
 
Position Overview
We are seeking a Junior Endpoint Engineer to support a critical security and technology remediation initiative focused on identifying, troubleshooting, and remediating outdated Java applications across a large Windows device environment.
This role will support the remediation of approximately 1,600 devices that require updates to Java applications, including outdated Java Runtime Environments (JREs) and Java Development Kits (JDKs), with the goal of completing the initiative by the end of 2026.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, PowerShell, and Windows endpoint management. This is an engineering-focused position rather than a traditional Tier 1/Tier 2 desktop support role. Candidates should be comfortable troubleshooting endpoint policies, agents, scripts, and configurations to determine why devices are not receiving or successfully applying required patches.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support a large-scale Java remediation and endpoint security initiative across approximately 1,600 Windows devices.
  • Identify and remediate outdated Java applications, including JREs and JDKs.
  • Troubleshoot endpoint issues preventing devices from receiving or successfully applying required patches.
  • Work within a co-managed endpoint environment utilizing both Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM.
  • Troubleshoot SCCM/MECM and Intune agents, policies, configurations, and deployment issues.
  • Validate that devices are properly receiving and applying required policies and software updates.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts used for remediation and endpoint management.
  • Analyze basic reports and endpoint data to identify devices requiring remediation.
  • Troubleshoot Windows endpoint configuration issues, including environment variables and application-related settings.
  • Work directly with end users when necessary to resolve issues resulting from Java updates or endpoint changes.
  • Assist with troubleshooting elevation and administrative access requirements, including familiarity with LAPS.
  • Document remediation activities, troubleshooting steps, and recurring issues.
  • Collaborate closely with endpoint engineering, infrastructure, security, and other technical teams.
  • Support additional endpoint remediation and security initiatives as business needs evolve.
 
Requirements
  • 2+ years of experience in endpoint management, systems administration, desktop engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with SCCM/MECM in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune or another cloud-based endpoint/mobile device management platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting.
  • Strong understanding of Windows operating systems and endpoint configurations.
  • Experience troubleshooting software deployment, patching, policies, agents, or endpoint management issues.
  • Ability to analyze technical data and reports to identify and resolve endpoint issues.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a technical engineering team.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with end users when technical issues require assistance.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in a co-managed SCCM/MECM and Intune environment.
  • Experience with Java remediation, JRE/JDK updates, or Java application troubleshooting.
  • Experience with ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus or similar enterprise patch-management tools.
  • Experience with Microsoft LAPS or other privileged-access/elevation technologies.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint security or remediation initiatives.
  • Experience with enterprise mobility/device management (MDM).
  • Experience with scripting or automation beyond basic PowerShell.
  • Prior experience supporting large-scale security or technology remediation projects.
  • Junior-level systems engineering or endpoint engineering experience.

job.title: Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst
job.description:
Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst

Join our client's dynamic team supporting the forefront of equity trading and regulatory compliance as a Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in ensuring our client's trading activities uphold the highest standards of market integrity and regulatory adherence. 

Job Details:

Duration: Permanent Full Time Employee
Pay Rate: $87,500- $125,000
Location:Hybrid 3-4x a week onsite NY

What You’ll Do:
  • Conduct thorough daily surveillance and data quality reviews of equity trading activity to ensure compliance with exchange and FINRA rules.
  • Oversee exception reports related to market manipulation risks, insider dealing, and abnormal trading patterns.
  • Manage daily CAT administration, data repairs, and internal reporting to maintain data integrity.
  • Analyze trading patterns for best execution, error rates, and overall trade surveillance effectiveness.
  • Perform comprehensive reviews covering various regulatory requirements including Reg NMS, Short Sales, and Trade Reporting.
  • Review electronic communications and contribute to regulatory inquiries and internal audits.
  • Collaborate with trading, compliance, and vendor teams to stay ahead of regulatory rule changes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of two (2) years in a Capital Markets supervision/compliance role within the financial services industry.
  • Knowledge of regulatory rules, including but not limited to CAT reporting, trade reporting, best execution, market manipulation, SEC order handling a plus.
  • Analytical skills to follow life cycle of orders, routes and executions.
  • Ability to interact directly with traders and sales personnel in order to understand particular circumstance of a transaction or instruct personnel on new procedures or requirements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with Fidessa a plus.
Licenses/Certifications
  • FINRA Registrations Series 7, 55/57 (or ability to pass within 1 year)

job.title: Senior AWS Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior AWS Data Engineer
100% Remote (Must reside in lower 48)
Contract (through end of year) with potential conversion (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)


Overview
We’re seeking a Senior AWS Data Engineer to help build and support enterprise, cloud-native data solutions in a large Financial Services environment. This role is primarily focused on AWS engineering, cloud data integration, ETL development, and enterprise data platforms.
Experience with Markit EDM (Cadis) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) is a strong plus, but this is not a traditional “Markit EDM Developer” role. Strong AWS-focused data engineers with enterprise integration experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, develop, and support enterprise AWS data solutions
  • Build scalable ETL pipelines and cloud-native integrations
  • Develop and support REST APIs for enterprise data platforms
  • Create and maintain cloud-based data ingestion and transformation workflows
  • Partner with Architecture, Data Engineering, and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize cloud performance
  • Support initiatives tied to data quality, governance, and enterprise integration
  • Deliver reusable, maintainable solutions using AWS best practices

Required Qualifications (Must Have)
  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience
  • Python
  • SQL
  • ETL development and data integration experience in enterprise environments
  • REST API development/integration experience
  • AWS services such as:
    • AWS Lambda
    • AWS Glue
    • EventBridge
  • Experience building cloud-native applications and supporting production systems

Preferred / Nice to Have
  • Markit EDM (Cadis) exposure
  • Master Data Management (MDM)
  • Security Master / Reference Data platforms or concepts
  • Snowflake
  • Kafka
  • C# / .NET
  • Financial Services background
  • Data governance / enterprise data management concepts

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (ANP/FNP) or Physician Assistant (PA-C) license in state of Wisconsin
  • Minimum of (3) years' experience at a provider level
  • Previous experience in: Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Orthopedics, Family Practice, or Critical Care type setting
  • Must be confident with drawing blood

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Medical surveillance: hearing conservation (audiometry exams), spirometry, drug testing, phlebotomy, etc.
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty) and coordinate treatment planning
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Provide onsite testing for strep pharyngitis, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia
  • Work collaboratively to recognize environmental hazards and/or stresses in or from the workplace that may cause sickness, impaired health, or discomfort among the workers; create preventative measures that ensure the health and safety of employees
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purposes of reducing illness and absenteeism
  • Provide proactive and mobile engagement with the workforce from a prevention standpoint; seek out interactions with employees and build relationships
  • Respond to medical emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Nationally Certified (ANCC or AANP) or NCCP
  • Current BLS
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing certified (CAOHC/COHC)
  • Certified Drug Test Collector/Certified DOT Specimen Collector
  • Computer skills with previous experience using EMR and MS Office products
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interview, teach and counsel patients and interact with multidisciplinary team members (EHS, HR, Medical Director)
  • Must be able to meet the physical demands of onsite work needs; ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds, frequent standing, walking, sitting, squatting

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your expertise in occupational medicine, injury prevention, ergonomics, and workplace wellness
  • Quality-focused clinical environment with dedicated time to educate, coach, and support patients
  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!


KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and we place healthcare professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

job.description:
Institutional Equity Sales Team Coordinator / Sales Assistant

Join a leading team in the dynamic world of institutional equity sales! We are seeking an energetic, highly organized individual to support our client's busy Sales team, ensuring smooth daily operations and outstanding client service. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the heart of capital markets activity, contributing directly to client engagement and operational excellence.

Job Details: 

Duration: Permanent FTE
Pay Rate: $75,000 W2
Location: Hybrid 3-4x a week onsite in NY

Key Responsibilities
  • Assist in preparing, formatting, and distributing daily market and sales notes to institutional clients.
  • Schedule and coordinate client meetings, conference calls, and Zoom meetings.
  • Log and maintain records of client interactions, meetings, and outreach activities.
  • Manage meeting requests and send calendar invitations for sales professionals and clients.
  • Support conference planning, client meeting allocations, and corporate access events.
  • Produce and distribute daily and weekly calendars detailing upcoming corporate access events and meetings.
  • Generate and maintain client model requests and related tracking reports.
  • Prepare daily corporate access reports for trading and sales teams.

  • Maintain and update client databases, contact information, and CRM records.
  • Process expense reports and assist with administrative documentation.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required.

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Zoom and Word.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

job.title: Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Manager
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a EHS Manager in Temple, TX. This role will be a responsible for responsible for leading and implementing environmental, health and safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will have a strong experience in preparing and filing of Tier II reporting, Steers, Form R, Storm Water Annual Reporting.
 
Title: EHS Manager
Duration: DH
Pay: $120,000/yr
Location: Temple, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm(varies)


Position Summary:

The EHS Manager is responsible for leading and implementing environmental, health and safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies and procedures. This role will drive a culture of safety, sustainability, and operational excellence within Palladio Industries chemical plant.

 

Key Responsibilities (Not inclusive):

· Site Compliance: Assure site compliance for all EHS regulations including preparing site permitting documents as needed in due time.

· Reporting: Prepare and submit correct reporting needed for the site to be compliant. Examples are wastewater quarterly and annual reporting and inspections, Tier II reporting, Steers reporting, Form R, Storm Water Annual Report, Industrial hazardous waste report, P2P (pollution prevention plan), TCEQ operating status report, among others.

· Policies, procedures and site communication material: Develop, implement and maintain EHS policies, procedures and site communication material in compliance with OSHA, EPA, PSM, and other applicable regulations.

· Risk assessment & Incident Investigation: Conduct risk assessments and drive implementation of corrective actions to mitigate hazards in the workplace. Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis to identify effective corrective and preventive actions. Follow up on implementation.

· Performance: drive EHS cultural positive change and site improvement. In accordance with Site Manager/Industrial Director, develop and maintain an effective EHS KPI grid to track improvement.

· Documentation Management: Keep all EHS records up to date and organized.

· People management and development: Develop and oversee EHS training programs for employees and contractors. Train and mentor site employees and contractors ensuring compliance with regulation, internal procedures and industry standards. Train employees and contractors for PIT (powered Industrial trucks) including forklift, boom lift, scissor lift etc. Foster a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement. Be the positive change agent.

· Audits and inspections: Conduct internal audits and coordinate/lead external regulatory inspections making sure site is ready and prepared at its best.

· Communication: Make sure all stakeholders are informed as needed. Prepare periodic and on request communication material and sessions to maintain positive traction and site visibility.

· Cross functional initiatives: Lead or participate in company cross functional initiatives.

· Designated personal certifications and/or licenses must be retained as hired or designated.

· Follow and utilize standard operating procedures.

· Comply with company policies, required regulatory and legal guidelines.

· Participate in all site safety training, activities, and drills. Safety is crucial to position.

 

Position Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field.

5+ years of EHS experience in a chemical manufacturing industrial environment.

Experience preparing site permitting documents

Experience preparing and filing site EHS reporting (e.g. Tier II, Steers, Form R, Storm water, etc.)- Required

Strong knowledge of OSHA, PHA, EPA, PHA,PSM, DOT and Environmental regulations.

Experience with risk assessment, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive organizational change.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Professional certifications such as CSP (Certified Safety Professional), CIH (Certified Industrial Hygienist), Six Sigma or equivalent experience.

Experience with Process Safety Management (PSM), PHA and hazardous chemical handling.

 

Skills/Experience:

· +5 years’ proven work experience as a EHS Manager or similar role in a chemical industrial setting.

· Experience with hazardous and Flammable chemicals, PSM (Process Safety Management), PHA, Waste management, and chemical industry site permitting. Familiarity with industry standard equipment.

· Proven managerial experience and good leadership skills.

· Adequate knowledge of business and management principles (budgeting, strategic planning, resource allocation and human resources).

· Computer literate, proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Word, Excel, Outlook and Power Point).

· Ability to lead/drive change, and influence/mentor others.

· Able to develop networks and build relationships.

· Ability to be trained in standard operating procedures.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills.

· Ability to read write and comprehend English and follow verbal instructions.

· Good trouble-shooting and problem-solving skills

· Basic math skills

 

Work Environment:

The activities of this position will include outdoor activities. This position will have periods of exposure to the elements. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be trained to safely and effectively work around energy of various types, including moving mechanical parts and vibration. The position includes designated areas where Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) must be worn. The typical PPE includes: Ear Protection, Respiratory Protection, Eye Protection, Hard Hats, Safety Glasses, Steel-Toed shoes or boots, Gloves, Chemical Protective Suits.

 

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, twisting, stooping, sitting, crouching, crawling, and climbing ladders. The employee may frequently lift and/or move items of 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Position may require entering confined spaces from time to time (under permit control).

job.title: Senior TPRM - GRC Consultant
job.description:
Senior TPRM and GRC Consultant
                                 Third-Party Risk Management Specialist

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite 
Location: Plano Texas or McKinney Texas
Start Date: Immediate

POSITION SUMMARY
IT Third-Party Risk Management professional to lead and strengthen the TPRM program within the Governance, Risk, and Compliance function.
  • This position manages the complete third-party risk lifecycle, including vendor onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, periodic reviews, remediation tracking, ongoing monitoring, and offboarding.
  • The ideal candidate has extensive experience evaluating technology vendors, identifying security and compliance risks, improving TPRM processes, and working independently with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on AuditBoard experience is strongly preferred, although candidates with strong RSA Archer experience will also be considered.
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the end-to-end third-party risk management lifecycle for new and existing vendors.
  • Conduct vendor due diligence, security risk assessments, control reviews, and periodic reassessments.
  • Evaluate vendor compliance with organizational security requirements and regulatory and industry standards.
  • Identify control gaps, document risk findings, recommend corrective actions, and track remediation through completion.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve TPRM policies, procedures, assessment methodologies, workflows, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Information Security, Compliance, and business teams to incorporate security requirements into vendor selection and contracting.
  • Maintain and optimize AuditBoard or RSA Archer for vendor assessments, workflow management, documentation, issue tracking, and reporting.
  • Monitor third-party risk metrics, emerging trends, remediation progress, and overall compliance posture.
  • Prepare risk reports, dashboards, and program updates for senior leadership.
  • Support internal and external audits involving third-party risk, cybersecurity governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory changes, and third-party risk management best practices.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum of five years of direct Third-Party Risk Management experience within an IT Security, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or GRC function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, control-gap identification, remediation tracking, periodic reviews, and offboarding.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, control standards, and regulatory requirements, including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and CCPA.
  • Hands-on experience with AuditBoard, RSA Archer, or a comparable GRC platform.
  • Experience partnering with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, reporting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work onsite Wednesday through Friday.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Hands-on experience configuring or optimizing AuditBoard TPRM workflows.
  • Experience developing, implementing, or maturing an enterprise Third-Party Risk Management program.
  • Experience creating executive-level risk reports, dashboards, and metrics.
  • CTPRP, CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or another relevant risk or cybersecurity certification.

job.title: Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Nurse Practitioner (NP) - Occupational Health
job.description:
Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) needed for a temporary contract opportunity with Yoh's medical center client located in Rothschild, Wisconsin.

This position supports the onsite clinic for a well-known manufacturing facility. The assignment is anticipated to start the week of September 7 and is expected to run for approximately three months, with the potential for extension. This role will provide onsite occupational health and preventive care services to help reduce and treat workplace injuries and illnesses.

Schedule (flexible):
40 hours per week available, Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (flexible - part time or full time)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Experience as a Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) is highly preferred.
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Responsible, friendly, and helpful with strong multitasking abilities.
  • Prior experience working in an occupational health or workplace clinic.
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Provide onsite services at a single location in Rothschild, WI.
  • Deliver ethical, evidence-based medical services to employees, both onsite and through virtual evaluations, while working within the recommendations of the Medical Director.
  • Complete timely and accurate electronic and non-electronic documentation.
  • Proactively engage with the workforce to support injury prevention and health promotion initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with the safety and first responder teams to address workplace health needs.
  • Work autonomously and proactively seek opportunities to interact with employees and build strong relationships.
  • Perform phlebotomy and collect urine samples as needed.
  • Conduct spirometry, audiometry, and drug testing.
  • Perform and/or coordinate new-hire physical examinations.
  • Provide onsite first aid and wellness screenings.
  • Provide case management and return-to-work services.
  • Administer and document annual vaccinations, spirometry testing, audiograms, drug and alcohol testing, biometric screenings, and medical questionnaires.
  • Coordinate assessment, treatment planning, and return-to-work processes with employees, healthcare providers, and employers.
  • Assess and educate patients regarding medications, illnesses, medical history, injury prevention strategies, and test results.
  • Evaluate work environments for potential hazards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Licensed Physician Assistant (PA).
  • DEA certification is not required.
  • Active Wisconsin license in good standing.
  • Current CPR/BLS certification for healthcare providers.
  • One or more years of experience in Occupational Health, Primary Care, Outpatient Care, or Urgent Care.
  • Demonstrated computer proficiency and the ability to quickly learn new systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and workflow management skills.
  • NIOSH Spirometry Training and/or related experience.
  • Ability to meet the physical demands of onsite work, including lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds and performing frequent standing, walking, sitting, and squatting.
What's In It For You?
  • Unique and rewarding experience.
  • Opportunity to support employees in a fast-paced workplace while promoting their health and well-being.
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday.
