job.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Analog/mixed
job.description:
Join Our Team as an Electrical Design Engineer – Analog/Mixed Signal!

Are you passionate about advancing cutting-edge avionics and power electronics systems? We’re seeking a talented Electrical Design Engineer to lead the design and development of high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that drive innovation across the aerospace industry. At the forefront of technology, you’ll play a vital role in creating avionics, power management, lithium battery systems, and sensor interfacing solutions that meet the highest standards for safety and reliability.

This exciting opportunity offers a chance to work across the entire product lifecycle—from concept to certification—on projects that impact commercial, business, defense, and advanced air mobility markets. Bring your expertise to a collaborative environment committed to excellence, integrity, and professional growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • Minimum of 5 years in analog and mixed-signal circuit design, especially for precision instrumentation, signal conditioning, and IC applications
  • Proficiency with schematic capture and simulation tools such as PADS, LTSpice, or similar
  • Strong understanding of mixed-signal simulation, PCB layout, and signal integrity
  • Knowledge of impedance matching, EMI/EMC standards (RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461)
  • Experience with power electronics, including AC/DC, DC/DC, and DC/AC conversion
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and results-oriented mindset
  • Superior verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT)
  • Previous work within the aviation industry
Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in analog/mixed-signal design
  • Experience designing avionics or aerospace systems is a plus
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to perform hardware testing, troubleshooting, and soldering in both office and lab environments
  • Familiarity with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and logic analyzers
  • Willingness to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including layout, mechanical, software, and certification engineers
  • Occasional travel may be required for certifications or project coordination
This is your chance to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, innovative environment. If you’re ready to contribute to high-stakes aerospace designs and grow your career, apply now and elevate your engineering journey with us!

job.title: Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Systems Integration Engineer
Seeking a hands-on Systems Integration Engineer to support the integration, bring-up, troubleshooting, and validation of complex electromechanical systems. This role is responsible for combining hardware, software, and mechanical components into fully functioning platforms, supporting prototype builds, system validation, and manufacturing readiness. This is a primarily onsite position with approximately 30% travel to engineering labs, supplier locations, and manufacturing facilities to support builds, integration activities, and issue resolution.

Scope:
• Integrate hardware, electrical, and software components into complete system builds.
• Perform system bring-up, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis on prototype and production platforms.
• Debug complex issues spanning mechanical, electrical, networking, and software domains.
• Execute system validation testing, collect data, and verify subsystem performance and interface requirements.
• Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and external suppliers to support system builds, production readiness, and resolve integration challenges.
• Document findings, communicate technical issues, and work closely with design teams to implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

Required:
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
• Hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting complex hardware/software systems in a laboratory, manufacturing, or production environment.
• Strong understanding of electrical, mechanical, and embedded system fundamentals.
• Experience performing structured root cause analysis and debugging multidisciplinary system issues.
• Working knowledge of Python, C++, or another object-oriented programming language.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, manufacturing, supplier, and operations teams.

Pluses:
• Experience with complex electromechanical systems, robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, automotive platforms, or similar technologies.
• Familiarity with sensors, embedded computing, wiring harnesses, power distribution, networking, and actuator systems.
• Hands-on experience using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and other electronic diagnostic equipment.
• Experience supporting prototype builds, manufacturing integration, new product introduction (NPI), or production launches in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Estimated Min Rate: $35.00
Estimated Max Rate: $50.00/hr +. Depends on work experience.

job.title: Occupational Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a full-time, 9/80 contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-known client located in Redondo Beach, CA.
 

This onsite clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative health services to support a large corporation. Interesting job getting to be a key part in keeping employees healthy, safe, and able to perform at their best through injury triage, wellness initiatives, and ongoing workplace health support.
-->SHIFTS: 9/80 schedule: Monday-Friday 6:30am to 4:00pm (30 minute lunch)
- One week Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm and Friday 6:30am to 3:00pm and next week, Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of California
  • Previous experience highly preferred: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Strong presentation skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Case management for work-related and non-work related injuries and illnesses, while collaborating with EHS
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Assist with the delivery of the medical surveillance program (audiometric, respiratory, vision, and urine collection)
  • Support company policy in regards to Drug and Alcohol Free Workplace - coordinating drug/alcohol testing (post incident and for cause)
  • Administer immunizations/vaccines
  • Provide counseling, health education, and training programs 
  • Dispense OTC medications
  • Respond to medical emergencies and administer first-aid to employees for job related illnesses and injuries

What You Need to Bring to the Table

  • BLS certified
  • Must be comfortable working autonomously
  • Prior experience using the EMR system, Cority, a big plus!
  • Preferred certifications: CAOHC (hearing conservation), NIOSH (spirometry), COHN (Certified Occupational Health Nurse), and CHES (Certified Health Education Specialist)
  • Proof of US Citizenship (ie valid US Passport or original US Birth Certificate) for security clearance/badging

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Expand your experience alongside a trusted and well-respected organization
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and we place health care professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

job.title: Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer
job.description:
Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer?

About the Role: We are seeking a highly capable and self-directed Senior Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer to lead vehicle-level software validation and development operations across embedded domains—chassis, body, thermal, and more. This role is critical in ensuring high software quality through robust in-vehicle testing and operational readiness of the development fleet.
You’ll collaborate closely with software, calibration, integration, and test engineering teams to plan, execute, and debug vehicle-level test campaigns, while driving day-to-day development activities with a high degree of autonomy. This role will also require travel to winter test proving grounds and other company test sites to support seasonal validation efforts and major release milestones.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  • Own and lead vehicle-level test planning and execution for pre-merge and post-merge software builds across multiple domains (chassis controls, body systems, thermal, etc.)
  • Drive end-to-end development fleet readiness including software flashing, configuration, instrumentation setup, and release coordination
  • Operate and evaluate vehicles in structured and exploratory test routes, validating embedded feature behavior and performance
  • Partner with technicians and garage teams to manage vehicle setup, diagnostics, and resolution of hardware/software issues
  • Lead issue triage and debugging efforts using CAN tools (e.g., CANalyzer, Canape, Vehicle Spy), log analysis, and collaboration with engineering owners
  • Document, track, and escalate software issues with clear context, reproduction steps, and logs in tools like Jira
  • Contribute to the creation and improvement of vehicle-level test processes, test plans, and validation workflows
  • Travel as needed to proving grounds (e.g., winter testing), test tracks, and company engineering sites to support vehicle testing and fleet operations
  • Afternoon, weekend, or nighttime testing may be required depending on development needs and test schedules
  • Provide mentorship to junior engineers and operators on validation best practices and vehicle test procedures



Basic Qualifications:
 
  • 5+ years of experience in vehicle-level software validation, systems integration, or embedded development
  • Strong proficiency with CAN tools, diagnostic interfaces, and log analysis for embedded systems
  • Demonstrated ability to operate development vehicles safely and confidently in a test environment
  • Hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams including SW engineers, technicians, and test operators
  • Solid understanding of automotive embedded systems, including body modules, thermal management, and chassis control ECUs
  • Proven track record of debugging complex vehicle-level issues

Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field
  • Accredited proving ground driver training
  • Experience with electric vehicle platforms and modern vehicle software architecture
  • Familiarity with software release tools and test case management systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel to remote test sites (including cold weather and high-altitude locations)
  • Experience supporting vehicle bring-up, calibration loops, or multi-domain integration testing
  • Knowledge of functional safety principles (ISO 26262) or automotive process frameworks (ASPICE)

job.title: Music Industry, Solutions Coordinator - Hybrid in NYC
job.description:
Solutions Coordinator within the music industry! 

- Hybrid onsite in NYC
- 6 month contract 
- $25/hr on W2

*candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponorship. No C2C!

Our company is seeking a Coordinator, Solutions to join our dynamic Enterprise team. In this role, you will work closely with various businesses across Sony Music supporting them and their artists and labels within the Orchard systems, overseeing key elements of the client experience, and synthesizing interactions across departments. You will be responsible for providing a centralized, solutions-based voice in support of these businesses as they work within The Orchard ecosystem and will supervise the comprehensive client onboarding process, focusing on a positive first experience and ongoing operational questions and concerns. This is a highly responsible role that requires proactive problem-solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a love for all types of music.


What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a representative of Orchard’s administrative teams (including legal, finance, and operations) to both Sony Music business units and their artists and labels, addressing issues, gathering feedback, and advocating for Sony Music business unit needs within the organization.
  • Main point of contact for questions pertaining to all operational functions across the organization, serving as a focal point of information and defining internal processes and procedures.
  • Assist in the training and continued education of Sony Music team members working within the Orchard systems, across all applications.
  • Advise on client product logistics and operations and manage complex digital release set-ups in accordance with client and campaign specified needs (timed releases, carveouts, tiered releases, etc).
  • Focus on clear, solution-based responses to internal and external queries regarding client questions.
  • Understand how to troubleshoot problems effectively and identify the right teams to interact with in order to get reliable solutions and answers.
  • Ability to handle high volume inbound needs from clients and ensure they are being addressed in a timely manner.

Who You Are:

  • Patient and empathetic.
  • Effective communicator on phone, email, and in person.
  • Resourceful, problem solver, and takes initiative - an expert and motivated troubleshooter.
  • Multi-tasker with supreme attention to detail, follow-through and effective prioritization.
  • Spanish language skills preferred, but not required.

job.title: UX Designer – Enterprise Design Systems
job.description:
UX Designer – Enterprise Design Systems
We are seeking a UX Designer to help build, maintain, and scale an enterprise design system for complex, data-heavy internal tools. This role will bridge design and front-end engineering by ensuring UI components and patterns are consistent, accessible, scalable, and aligned with production implementation.

Scope:
• Build, maintain, and expand Figma component libraries.
• Audit and document UI patterns to improve consistency and component adoption.
• Develop accessible design patterns aligned with WCAG standards.
• Define design tokens and theming structures.
• Create usage guidelines, interaction specifications, and contribution standards.
• Support product teams adopting the design system through collaboration and office hours.
• Partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to align designs with production implementation.
• Evaluate AI-assisted tools for documentation, linting, and design-to-code workflows.

Required:
• 3+ years of experience building, scaling, or maintaining enterprise design systems.
• Advanced proficiency with Figma, including variables, component variants, auto-layout, and token workflows.
• Strong understanding of WCAG and accessible design practices.
• Experience designing complex, data-heavy, or high-density interfaces.
• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a detail-oriented approach.
• Experience documenting UI patterns, design standards, and interaction specifications.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with product designers, product managers, and software engineers.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.

Pluses:
• Experience with Angular Material or Google Material Design.
• Understanding of Angular component structures, theming, and front-end implementation constraints.
• Experience with design tokens, design system tooling, or token automation.
• Experience designing for robotics, simulation, mapping, autonomous vehicles, developer tools, or other complex technical environments.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, automated linting, documentation generation, or design-to-code tools.

job.title: Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer
job.description:
Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer

The Motion Controls Systems Engineer will participate in the system level design activities for the propulsion and braking system, with a special focus on the electrical and controls integration to the rest of the vehicle system. You will Conceptualize, Design, Engineer, Develop and support the launch of next generation vehicle platform architectures for electric vehicles.

Responsabilities:
  • Participate in vehicle systems and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.
  • Distill product-level requirements and decompose them from vehicle-level motion features down to ECU/software-component functional requirements.
  • Define braking and propulsion functions and work with the hardware, software, architecture, safety and other cross-functional teams to deliver said functionality.
  • Participate in functional safety and failure avoidance analysis of complex electrical and software vehicle subsystems (HARA, FMEAs, etc.).
  • Develop and own motion related vehicle features (drive modes, terrain modes, vehicle hold, speedometer, odometer, cruise control, brake assistance, etc.).
  • Define diagnostic interfaces (DTCs, health monitoring, driver notifications, etc.) relating to the propulsion and braking systems.
  • Build the feature implementation strategy and develop functional boundary diagrams, sequence diagrams, define feature attributes, assess homologation requirements, and other deliverables.
  • Define system level test plans for hardware and software features (virtualized testing environments, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), etc.).
  • Use field data to improve design and performance of the system.
  • Report features development progress and maturity at various program milestones.
  • Participate in architectural and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.

The minimum requirements we seek:
  • BS in Engineering degree in an equivalent field, or equivalent experience.
  • 0-5+ years of experience in systems design, systems architecture, propulsion or brakes systems, integration, and test validation.
  • Strong electrical and systems engineering fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of systems development, vehicle architecture, propulsion technologies, brake system technologies, software/hardware tool development.
  • A systems approach to design and development with the desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement.

Should have experience with some of the following:
  • Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)
  • Traction Control
  • Stability Control
  • Friction & Regen Brake Blending
  • Trailer Brake Controls
  • Hydraulic brake boost assist
  • One-Pedal Driving
  • Hill-start assist
  • Brake torque vectoring
  • Brake Pedal Override
  • Automatic Emergency Braking / Pre-Collision Assistance
  • Dynamic Braking  / Dynamic Deceleration
  • Electronic Park Brake Control features
  • Hydraulic brake boost Control features
  • ESC control features

Preferred Requirements:
  • M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechanical engineering.
  • Proven technical expertise in Propulsion and/or Brakes Systems Design and understanding of the intricacies of the subsystem.
  • Experience in the test, validation, and calibration of vehicle motion control features (e.g., longitudinal/lateral dynamics, regenerative braking, traction control) using HIL/SIL or in-vehicle testing.
  • Experience with electric machine design and DC/AC inverter design.
  • Experience with smart actuators, brake-by-wire systems, and integrated motion controllers.
  • Experience with Vehicle Network Protocols such as CAN, LIN & Automotive Ethernet.
  • Experience in leading product development from concept to deployment.
  • Experience in MATLAB, Python, or equivalent tools for modeling and analysis.
  • Experience operating within an Agile software development framework utilizing modern CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and software deployment.
  • Proficiency in fundamentals of vehicle architecture, embedded systems design, RTOS’s and real-time networking.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety standards (industry certification is highly preferred).

Estimated Max Rate: $90.00

job.title: Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
job.description:
Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Job Overview
The Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer will participate in the overall management and end-user support of the organization’s Messaging and SaaS offerings.
This position will primarily provide support to the end-user population for Exchange Online, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Box, including Microsoft 365 account and license administration. Experience with additional Microsoft 365 components is a plus.
 
The ideal candidate is a customer-focused support professional with strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, and the ability to work effectively across teams in a complex enterprise environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide Tier 2 end-user support for Messaging and SaaS-based tools, including:
    • Exchange Online
    • Microsoft Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Microsoft OneDrive
    • Box
  • Support Microsoft 365 account and license administration
  • Apply and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams policies
  • Perform mailbox maintenance and access management
  • Support message archiving, retrieval, and deletion
  • Troubleshoot end-user collaboration and messaging issues
  • Create and maintain process and environment documentation
  • Support and develop ServiceNow ticket automation
  • Create and modify PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Partner with other technical teams to resolve complex infrastructure and application issues
  • Participate in on-call support rotations
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience providing end-user support for Microsoft applications, specifically:
    • Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
  • 2+ years of experience with basic Box administration and end-user troubleshooting
  • 1–2 years of experience working with ServiceNow
  • 1–2 years of experience administering and supporting OneDrive
  • 1+ year of experience creating and modifying PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Experience supporting Exchange Online
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 account and licensing administration
  • Experience with mailbox and access management
  • Exposure to additional Microsoft 365 technologies
  • Relevant and current technical certifications
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues involving multiple technical teams
  • Desire to learn and support emerging cloud technologies
  • Hands-on experience working within complex enterprise infrastructure environments
  • Experience within a highly regulated industry
  • Previous participation in an on-call support rotation

job.title: Human Resources Operations Partner
job.description:
Human Resources Operations Partner
Position Overview We are seeking an organized and motivated People Business Partner to provide hands-on support across People Operations, annual talent programs, reporting, and HR process improvement initiatives. This position is execution-focused and ideal for an early-to-mid-career HR professional who enjoys managing data, coordinating multiple projects, and supporting performance and compensation processes.

The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable working in Workday, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement: Remote or hybrid based on proximity to an office
Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours per week
Contract Duration: 6–12 months with potential for extension or conversion

Key Responsibilities Support annual HR processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.

  • Enter and complete HR transactions in Workday.
  • Pull, review, and analyze Workday reports and employee data.
  • Conduct data audits and maintain accuracy during performance, compensation, and talent cycles.
  • Coordinate project timelines, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items.
  • Prepare status reports, executive summaries, presentations, briefing materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage logistics, reporting, communications, and issue resolution throughout annual HR programs.
  • Develop process documentation, standard operating procedures, playbooks, and job aids.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across People Operations.
  • Coordinate with leaders, employees, and HR stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects.
Required Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of HR, People Operations, HR Business Partner, or related experience.
  • Hands-on experience using Workday to enter transactions, pull reports, and review data.
  • Experience supporting performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, or other annual HR programs.
  • Strong reporting, tracking, data-management, and process-coordination skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to perform administrative and execution-focused responsibilities.

job.title: Research Engineer – Transportation
job.description:
Research Engineer – Transportation (Thermoplastics & Product Commercialization) Join a collaborative, highly technical team focused on bringing next-generation polymer-based materials to market across North American transportation segments. In this role, you’ll lead development programs that take thermoplastic compounds and masterbatches from concept through scale-up and commercialization—partnering closely with customers and cross-functional teams to solve real performance challenges and deliver differentiated, production-ready solutions. This is a fully onsite position, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on strategic growth priorities in transportation markets.

Required Skills
  • Proven experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer-based compounds and/or masterbatches (aerospace high-performance polymer development experience is also relevant)
  • Ability to support R&D from concept development through commercialization, including scale-up and manufacturing support
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of polymer processing, compounding, and formulation development
  • Understanding of thermoplastics manufacturing processes and automation
  • Working knowledge of DOE (Design of Experiments), statistical analysis, and data-driven product development
  • Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills (internal teams and customers)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and drive timelines, deliverables, and quality expectations
Nice to Have Skills
  • Experience with engineering thermoplastics, polyolefins, and twin-screw extrusion
  • Background in transportation material qualification
  • Familiarity with automotive and/or aerospace OEM specifications
  • Experience with weatherable materials, flame-retardant systems, and/or color-critical applications
  • Exposure to stage-gate or structured innovation/product development systems
  • Interest or experience integrating sustainability targets (e.g., recyclability, bio-based content, durability)
Preferred Education and Experience
  • M.S. preferred in Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field (Ph.D. or advanced degree also valued)
  • Bachelor’s degree considered with strong, hands-on industry experience
  • 5+ years of experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer compounds/masterbatches for transportation markets (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense, recreational, utility vehicles)
Bring your formulation expertise and commercialization mindset to a role built for real ownership—apply today to help deliver the next wave of transportation materials from lab to market.

job.title: Occupational Health RN
job.description:
Occupational Health RN needed for a direct opportunity with Yoh’s occupational health clinic located in New Haven, IN. This RN must be able to work independently within the industrial manufacturing environment.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 6a-3p or 7a-4p (minimal on-call after hours for injury management)
Type: Direct permanent placement
Pay: $63-78K plus generous annual bonus and substantial benefits package

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Treatment of on-site injuries and referral to outside medical care as needed
  • Case management for injured workers and facilitate return to work
  • Provide medical surveillance for all employees including but not limited to annual audiograms, spirometry, vision screening and lead testing
  • Conduct new hire pre-employment drug and alcohol screening & coordinate medical examinations
  • Participate in ergonomics assessments and job hazard analyses
  • Administration of the Drug and Alcohol program according to company policy
  • Responsible for training employees in First Aid and CPR/AED as Medical Responders to aid in the care of injured workers
  • Responsible for training employees on Bloodborne Pathogens, Hearing Conservation, Violence in the Workplace, Ergonomics and Heat Stress to meet OSHA requirements
  • Advise on Workers’ Compensation claims, as needed
  • FMLA Administration
  • Maintain HIPPA compliant documentation
  • Accountable for delivery of agreed to regional health metrics and outcomes
  • Purchase all supplies required for the first aid clinic
  • Develop and meet site budget expectations
  • Drive increased health outcomes including reducing population health risks, managing and eliminating workplace health risks and supporting improved business outcomes through advancing employee health and wellbeing
  • Willingness to work closely with the Safety Coordinators at the division level to recognize hazards and prevent injury
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Active RN license in state of practice
  • 2 or more years hospital or clinic nursing experience
  • Excellent assessment skills in a clinical setting
  • Phlebotomy
  • Current CPR/AED certification
  • Travel, as needed
  • May not be related to another employee at location of employment
Preferred Experience:
  • 3 or more years of experience in occupational nursing or emergency nursing and/or clinic experience
  • 3 or more years of experience in a manufacturing, industrial, and/or occupational environment
  • Working knowledge of regulatory areas (ADA, OSHA, FMLA, Workers’ Compensation)
  • CPR/AED Instructor
  • Health coaching/certification
  • Certified Occupational Health Nurse

  • Bonus opportunities 
  • Stock Benefits
  • Profit Sharing and Retirement Savings
  • Medical, Educational, & Life Insurance coverage
  • Weekends and holidays off

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Supplier Quality Engineer to join our aerospace and defense technology client. This opportunity is ideal for candidates who are within a commutable distance to Irvine, CA and are open to an onsite work environment with significant travel requirements.
See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP. Title: Supplier Quality Engineer
Compensation: $100k - $128k base + bonus (base salary depends on experience)
Type: Direct Hire
Industry: Aerospace / Defense Technology
Eligibility: Must be a US Person (ITAR environment) Responsibilities
  • Partner with internal teams and external suppliers to evaluate, monitor, and improve supplier quality performance.
  • Lead resolution of supplier-related nonconformances to prevent production disruptions and customer impact.
  • Drive root cause investigations and corrective action processes, ensuring timely and effective closure.
  • Review and approve supplier corrective action responses, prioritizing based on business and operational impact.
  • Identify supplier risks related to product quality or safety and escalate appropriately.
  • Support supplier development initiatives, including training and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Act as a technical expert for supplier-related quality concerns and provide guidance on complex issues.
  • Analyze supplier performance data and recommend process or product improvements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams on quality initiatives.
  • Participate in audits and ensure supplier compliance with applicable industry standards.
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support quality and operational goals.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field).
  • 10+ years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or related engineering discipline.
  • Strong background in root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies (e.g., 8D, A3).
  • Experience with quality systems and tools such as PFMEA, control plans, DOE, Lean, and Six Sigma.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and engineering documentation (including GD&T).
  • Familiarity with aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100, AS9110, AS9120) and inspection practices.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Minitab, or similar).
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP is a plus.
  • Knowledge of APQP or advanced product quality planning processes is preferred.
  • Prior auditing experience and/or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development practices.
Additional Requirements
  • Valid driver’s license with ability to travel frequently (up to 50%, domestic and international).
  • Passport required; must be comfortable with short-notice travel.

job.description:
HR People Operations Partner

Position Overview We are seeking an organized and motivated People Business Partner to provide hands-on support across People Operations, annual talent programs, reporting, and HR process improvement initiatives. This position is execution-focused and ideal for an early-to-mid-career HR professional who enjoys managing data, coordinating multiple projects, and supporting performance and compensation processes.

The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable working in Workday, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement: Remote or hybrid based on proximity to an office
Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours per week
Contract Duration: 6–12 months with potential for extension or conversion

Key Responsibilities Support annual HR processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.

  • Enter and complete HR transactions in Workday.
  • Pull, review, and analyze Workday reports and employee data.
  • Conduct data audits and maintain accuracy during performance, compensation, and talent cycles.
  • Coordinate project timelines, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items.
  • Prepare status reports, executive summaries, presentations, briefing materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage logistics, reporting, communications, and issue resolution throughout annual HR programs.
  • Develop process documentation, standard operating procedures, playbooks, and job aids.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across People Operations.
  • Coordinate with leaders, employees, and HR stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects.
Required Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of HR, People Operations, HR Business Partner, or related experience.
  • Hands-on experience using Workday to enter transactions, pull reports, and review data.
  • Experience supporting performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, or other annual HR programs.
  • Strong reporting, tracking, data-management, and process-coordination skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to perform administrative and execution-focused responsibilities.

job.title: Data Center BA
job.description:
Data Center Business Analyst
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Onsite) – onsite interview required
 
Position Summary
The Data Center Business Analyst will support Data Center Projects and Operations by gathering and documenting business and technical requirements, managing project documentation, tracking financials and KPIs, creating JIRA stories, and supporting operational analysis. This role will work closely with Project Managers, Operations, Facilities, Engineering Teams, and functional stakeholders to improve processes, drive project execution, and support operational resilience initiatives, including disaster recovery and Black Start planning.
 
Responsibilities
  • Gather, analyze, and document business, technical, and non-functional requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, process flows, MOPs, and release plans.
  • Support project planning, scope management, scheduling, and status reporting.
  • Create and manage JIRA stories, tasks, and action items.
  • Maintain documentation within Confluence and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI metrics to support operational and project decision-making.
  • Analyze current processes and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
  • Support Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools and reporting.
  • Assist with project financial tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Black Start readiness activities, including recovery documentation, dependency mapping, and tabletop exercises.
  • Prepare meeting minutes, track follow-up actions, and coordinate with stakeholders across multiple teams.
  • Travel to data center facilities as required.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of Business Analyst experience supporting Data Center, Infrastructure, or Technology projects.
  • Experience working with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.
  • Strong knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating them into technical deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting disaster recovery, operational resiliency, or Black Start initiatives is preferred.
  • Understanding of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and capacity management, is a plus.

job.title: Business System Analyst
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for an IT System Analyst – Veeva PromoMats & MedComms .This role will support Veeva Vault applications used by Medical and Commercial teams, with a focus on content management, approval workflows, digital asset management, platform administration, and continuous process improvement. The ideal candidate brings hands-on Veeva PromoMats and MedComms experience along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions within a regulated environment.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: IT System Analyst– Veeva PromoMats & MedComms
Location: Princeton, NJ (Hybrid)
Compensation: $145,000–$155,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications
Type: Full-Time / Direct Hire
 
**This role is not able to provide sponsorship. Candidates must be able to work on our clients W2 without sponsorship now or in the future**

Responsibilities
  • Support the administration, maintenance, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of Veeva PromoMats and MedComms applications.
  • Partner with Medical, Commercial, IT, and other business stakeholders to gather requirements and improve content review and approval processes.
  • Configure and optimize workflows supporting medical, legal, and regulatory review activities across multiple business groups and markets.
  • Participate in application governance by coordinating proposed changes, approvals, priorities, and platform enhancements with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support and expand Digital Asset Management capabilities, including asset organization, metadata, localization, content reuse, and distribution.
  • Monitor application performance and content workflows to identify bottlenecks, user experience issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Evaluate new Veeva capabilities and coordinate prototypes, testing, releases, and implementation activities with business partners.
  • Support platform upgrades and configuration changes while following established SDLC, validation, testing, and documentation requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, test cases, user documentation, and system administration materials.
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize competing requests and recommend practical solutions based on business impact, compliance considerations, and platform best practices.
  • Ensure application processes and changes align with applicable security, privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 6+ years of relevant experience supporting digital platforms, marketing technology, content management, or related business applications.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Veeva PromoMats and/or Veeva MedComms, including workflow configuration, administration, implementation, or optimization.
  • Strong understanding of content review and approval processes within a regulated life sciences environment.
  • Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM), including metadata, source-file management, content reuse, localization, and asset distribution.
  • Experience administering or supporting Veeva Vault applications and managing platform enhancements.
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate stakeholder needs into functional and technical solutions.
  • Experience supporting application testing, releases, documentation, and SDLC processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong attention to compliance, data privacy, security, and documentation requirements

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Soldering Technician
job.description:
About the Role: Solder Technician 

You will be joining a world-class Satellite Manufacturing team. Currently, our production demands require a highly skilled Contract Solder Technician to take ownership of specialized, high-complexity assembly tasks. 

This role is designed for a technical expert who can hit the ground running, relieving pressure on our core team by independently managing high-volume production of intricate components. You will work with in-house custom jigs and specialized flight hardware where precision is the only acceptable standard. 

Impact You’ll Own: 

  • Specialized Flight Assembly: Take full ownership of complex soldering tasks, including torque rod assemblies and delicate battery tab interconnects. 

  • High-Volume Execution: Independently perform precision rework and assembly on a high volume of PCBAs daily. 

  • Jig-Based Precision: Use and maintain in-house custom fixtures/jigs to ensure repeatable, high-reliability solder joints on non-standard components. 

  • Precision Rework: Expertly add/remove components, install switches, and attach shields to boards using a microscope. 

  • Workflow Management: Use in-house software to track work progress and maintain digital records of throughput. 

  • Operational Excellence: Organize physical hardware on trays systematically and manage a shifting queue of priorities without constant supervision. 

What You Bring: 

  • Specific Mastery: Proven experience soldering torque rods, magnetics, or high-current battery tabs (highly preferred). 

  • Daily Precision Experience: A career background where high-reliability soldering under a microscope was the primary daily function, not a secondary task. 

  • Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and utilize proprietary in-house jigs and tooling for complex mechanical-to-electrical interfaces. 

  • Independent Drive: Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain high productivity in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with electronic part numbering systems and the ability to read complex drawings/schematics. 

  • Certification: IPC-A-610 or J-STD-001 (Active or recently expired). 

What Makes You Stand Out: 

  • NASA 8739.3/.2 or J-STD-001 Space Addendum certification. 

  • Experience with BGA rework stations and X-ray inspection. 

  • Previous experience in Aerospace or Medical Device manufacturing. 

  • Experience with wire-to-tab bonding or high-vibration environment assembly.
